verses.text: Umwami Dawidi amaze gukura akagera mu busaza, nta kintu cashobora kumumara imbeho, mbere naho bamupfuka uburengeti bwinshi ntiyashobora gususuruka.
Abasavyi biwe baravuga bati: “Reka tumuronderere inkumi yo kumusanga, imubungabunge, izoje iramuryama i ruhande kugira ngo isusurutse umwami wacu.”
Nuko barondera inkumi nziza muri Isirayeli, maze baronka Abishagi, Umunyashunemukazi, bamuzanira umwami.
Uwo mukobwa yari mwiza cane; afata neza umwami, aramubungabunga, ariko umwami ntiyigeze aryamana na we nk’umugore.

Muri ico gihe, Adoniya umuhungu Dawidi yavyaye ku mugore wiwe Hagiti atangura kwishira hejuru ati: “Ni jewe nzoba umwami.” Nuko yironderera imikogote n’amafarasi hamwe n’abasoda mirongo itanu bo kugendera imbere yiwe.
(Se Dawidi ntiyari bwigere amukankamira ati: “Ivyo ugira ni ibiki?” Yari umuhungu mwiza cane yakurikira Abusalomu.)
Adoniya agisha inama Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya, hamwe na Abiyatari umuherezi, na bo baramushigikira.
Ariko Sadoki umuherezi, Benaya mwene Yehoyada, Natani umuvugishwa, Shimeyi na Reyi hamwe n’abasoda bagendanira Dawidi ntibifatanya na Adoniya.
Adoniya ashikana ibimazi vy’intama, impene hamwe n’amashashi y’inka kw’Ibuye ry’i Zoheleti hafi ya Eni-Rogeli. Atumira abahungu bavukana ari bo bana b’umwami, ndetse n’abatware b’i Buyuda bose,
ariko ntiyatumira Natani umuvugishwa canke Benaya n’abasoda bagendanira umwami, canke mwenewabo Salomo.
Maze Natani abaza Batisheba nyina wa Salomo ati: “Mbega woba wumvise ko Adoniya umuhungu wa Hagiti, yiyimitse nk’umwami, umwami wacu Dawidi atabizi?
Reka rero ndakugire inama y’ukuntu worokora ubuzima bwawe n’ubw’umuhungu wawe Salomo.

Genda ku mwami Dawidi umubwire uti: ‘Mwami wanje, mbega ntiwandahiye uti: “Ni ukuri umuhungu wawe Salomo ni we azonsubirira yicare ku ntebe y’ubwami bwanje”? None ni kubera iki Adoniya ari we yabaye umwami?’
Ukiriko uravugana n’umwami, nanje ndaza kwinjira nemeze ivyo uzoba uriko uravuga.”
Nuko Batisheba aja kuraba umwami mu cumba ciwe, aho Abishagi Umunyashunemukazi yari amusangiye kuko yari ashaje cane.
Batisheba yikubita imbere yiwe, arapfukama. Umwami aramubaza ati: “Wipfuza iki?”
Na we aramwishura ati: “Mwami wanje, ni wewe wasezeraniye umusavyi wawe imbere y’ Uhoraho uti: ‘Umuhungu wawe Salomo ni we azoba umwami, ansubirire, ni we azokwicara ku ntebe yanje y’ubwami.’
Ariko Adoniya ni we yabaye umwami, kandi na wewe mwami wanje nta vyo wamenye.
Yatanze ibimazi vy’inka nyinshi, amashashi avyibushe hamwe n’intama, atumira abahungu b’umwami bose, atumira Abiyatari umuherezi na Yowabu umugabisha w’ingabo, ariko ntiyatumira Salomo umusavyi wawe.
Mwami wanje, Isirayeli yose ihanze amaso wewe, kugira ngo imenye uwuzosubirira umwami wanje ku ntebe yiwe.
Nutagira ico ukoze ga mwami wanje, twe n’umuhungu wanje Salomo tuzofatwa nk’abanyakibi niwamara guhamvya ba sogokuruza.”
Batisheba akiriko aravugana n’umwami, Natani umuvugishwa na we aba arashitse.
Babarira umwami bati: “Natani umuvugishwa ari ngaha.” Nuko ashikira umwami, yikubita imbere yiwe, aramwunamira.
Natani abaza umwami ati: “Mwami nyeningoma, wahisemwo ko Adoniya aba ari we agusubirira, akicara ku ntebe yawe y’ubwami?

Uwu musi yatanze ibimazi vyinshi vy’inka, amashashi avyibushe hamwe n’intama. Yatumiye abahungu b’umwami, umugabisha w’ingabo, hamwe na Abiyatari umuherezi. Ubu turiko turavugana bariko bararya banywa, bavuga bati: ‘Niharambe umwami Adoniya!’
Ariko ga mwami wanje, twe na Sadoki umuherezi, na Benaya mwene Yehoyada hamwe n’umusavyi wawe Salomo, ntiyadutumiye.
None ga nyaguhora ku ngoma, ivyo ni wewe wabikoze utamenyesheje abasavyi bawe uwuzogusubirira ku ntebe y’ubwami?”
Umwami Dawidi arishura ati: “Nimumpamagarire Batisheba!” Nuko Batisheba arinjira ahagarara imbere y’umwami.
Umwami aca asubiramwo ya ndahiro ati: “Ndakurahiye Uhoraho , uwandokoye mu magorwa yose,
ko Salomo umuhungu wawe ari we azonsubirira, akicara ku ntebe y’ubwami uhereye uwu musi nyene, nk’uko nari narabikurahiye imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli.”
Nuko Batisheba aca yikubita imbere yiwe, arapfukama, avuga ati: “Niharambe umwami wanje Dawidi!”
Dawidi aca avuga ati: “Nimumpamagarire Sadoki umuherezi, Natani umuvugishwa, na Benaya mwene Yehoyada.” Bashitse imbere y’umwami, arababwira ati:
“Fata Salomo n’abatware banje mumanuke kw’iriba ry’i Gihoni, Salomo agendere ku nyumbu yanje.
Sadoki umuherezi na Natani umuvugishwa baheze bamurobanuze amavuta nk’umwami wa Isirayeli. Muvuze inzamba, mwongere muvuge n’ijwi rirenga muti: ‘Niharambe umwami Salomo!’
Muce mudugana na we, yicare ku ntebe y’ubwami. Ni we ngize umukuru wo muri Isirayeli n’i Buyuda.”
Benaya mwene Yehoyada yishura umwami ati: “Amen! Nibibe nk’uko ubivuze, mwami! Uhoraho Imana y’umwami wanje, abishitse!
Nk’uko Uhoraho yabanye n’umwami wanje, azobane na Salomo, akomeze ingoma yiwe gusumvya n’iy’umwami wanje Dawidi!”
Nuko Sadoki umuherezi, Natani umuvugishwa, Benaya mwene Yehoyada, Abakereti hamwe n’Abapeleti baramanuka, bashira Salomo ku nyumbu y’umwami Dawidi, baramuherekeza bamujana i Gihoni.
Sadoki umuherezi afata ihembe ry’amavuta ryari mw’Ihema, arobanura Salomo. Baca bavuza inzamba, bavuga n’ijwi rirenga bati: “Niharambe umwami Salomo!”
Abantu bose baca badugana na we, bavuza imyironge, banezerewe cane, biha akamo, gushika n’aho isi inyiganyiga.
Adoniya hamwe n’abo yari yatumiye bumva ako kamo bariko baraheraheza ibirori vyabo. Yowabu yumvise inzamba, arabaza ati: “Ivyo ni ibiki? Urwo rwamo rwose mu gisagara ni urw’iki?”
Ataranaheza kuvuga, Yonatani mwene Abiyatari umuherezi aba arashitse. Adoniya amubwira ati: “Injira, kuko umuntu mwiza nka wewe utegerezwa kuba uzanye inkuru nziza.”
Yonatani na we amwishura ati: “Oya na mba! Umwami wacu Dawidi yimitse Salomo nk’umwami.
Umwami yamurungikanye Sadoki umuherezi, Natani umuvugishwa, Benaya mwene Yehoyada, Abakereti n’Abapeleti, bamushira ku nyumbu y’umwami,
Sadoki umuherezi na Natani umuvugishwa bamurobanuza amavuta nk’umwami i Gihoni. Baca bavayo baduga biha akamo bamushimagiza, igisagara na co kinezeranwa na bo. Urwo rwamo rwose mwumva ni ico ruvako.
Ikindi na co, Salomo yamaze kwicara ku ntebe y’ubwami.

Abatware b’i bwami bose bagiye gukeza umwami Dawidi bati: ‘Imana yawe ikomeze Salomo, izina ryiwe ribe rurangiranwa gusumba iryawe, n’ingoma yiwe ikomere gusumba iyawe!’ Umwami na we aho ari ku buriri aca arunama ashima Imana,
avuga ati: ‘ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli nahimbazwe, we yemereye amaso yanje kubona umusubirizi wanje uwu musi.’ ”
Abari kumwe na Adoniya bumvise ivyo, baterwa n’ubwoba bwinshi, barashwiragira.
Ariko Adoniya, kubera gutinya Salomo, aca ariruka afata amahembe y’igicaniro.
Maze umuntu araza abwira Salomo ati: “Adoniya yatinye umwami Salomo, none yafashe amahembe y’igicaniro. Yavuze ati: ‘Umwami Salomo narahire ko aticisha inkota umusavyi wiwe uwu musi.’ ”
Salomo yishura ati: “Nimba yemera ko agiye kwubaha umwami, nta n’agashatsi kamuvako. Ariko nihagira ikibi kimubonekako, arapfa nta kabuza.”
Nuko umwami Salomo atuma abantu bamukura ku gicaniro. Adoniya araza yikubita imbere y’umwami Salomo, Salomo na we amubwira ati: “Niwitahire.”
Dawidi yegereje gupfa, yihanikiririza umuhungu wiwe Salomo ati:
“Ehe ngiye gufata inzira abo kw’isi bose bafata. Ushikame, ube umugabo.

Uze ushire umutima ku vyo Uhoraho Imana yawe yihanikiriza, ugendere mu nzira ziwe. Uze witondere amategeko n’amabwirizwa yiwe, ivyo yashinze n’ivyo yategetse nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe vya Mose. Ivyo bizotuma ivyo ukora vyose bikugendera neza aho uzoja hose.

Niwabikora, Uhoraho azoshitsa ivyo yansezeraniye. Yambwiye ati: ‘Uruvyaro rwawe nirwigenza uko bibereye, rukankurikira mu bwizigirwa n’imitima yarwo yose n’imishaha yarwo yose, ntuzokwigera ubura uwo kugusubirira ku ngoma ya Isirayeli.’

Ubu rero urazi ivyo Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya yangiriye mu kwica abagabisha b’ingabo za Isirayeli babiri, Abuneri mwene Neri na Amasa mwene Yeteri. Yasheshe amaraso yabo mu gihe c’amahoro, nk’aho boba baguye ku rugamba, gutyo yandurisha umukanda wiwe n’ibirato vyiwe amaraso y’abantu ata co bazira.
Uzomukorere ico ubona ko kibereye, ariko ntuze umureke ngo yisazire, ngo amanukane imvi ziwe mu mva amahoro.
Ariko uze ugirire neza bene Baruzilayi Umunyagileyadi, uzokwame ubatumira gusangira nawe ku meza ibihe vyose, bangiriye neza igihe nahunga mwenewanyu Abusalomu.

Kandi uze wibuke Shimeyi mwene Gera Umubenyamini, w’i Bahurimu. Yamvumye imivumo myinshi igihe nariko ndahungira i Mahanayimu. Igihe yaza kuntegerera kuri Yorodani, namurahiye Uhoraho nti: ‘Sinzokuranduza inkota.’
Ariko ubu ntumufate nk’aho ata kimwagira. Uri umugabo w’ubwenge, uzomenya ingene uzomugenza. Imvi ziwe azozimanukane i kuzimu ziriko amaraso.”
Nuko Dawidi ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa mu Gisagara ca Dawidi.
Dawidi yaganje Isirayeli imyaka mirongo ine: imyaka indwi yabaye i Heburoni, iyindi mirongo itatu n’itatu aba i Yerusalemu.
Maze Salomo yicara ku ntebe y’ubwami ya se Dawidi, ingoma yiwe irakomera.
Igihe kimwe Adoniya mwene Hagiti aja kuraba Batisheba nyina wa Salomo. Batisheba aramubaza ati: “Ugenzwa n’amahoro?” Na we ati: “Egome ngenzwa n’amahoro.”
Arabandanya ati: “Ndafise ico ndakubwira.” Batisheba ati: “Ndaguteze amatwi.”
Aravuga ati: “Urazi ko ingoma yari iyanje. Abisirayeli bose bashaka ko ndababera umwami. Ariko vyarahindutse, ubwami bwegukiye mwenewacu, kuko yabuhawe n’ Uhoraho .
None rero mfise ico ndagusaba, kandi ndakwinginze ntunyankire.” Batisheba ati: “Wipfuza ko ndagukorera iki?”
Adoniya amwishura ati: “Mvugira ku mwami Salomo ndazi arakwumvira. Munsabire anyemerere ndongore Abishagi, umukobwa w’i Shunemu.”
Batisheba aca amubwira ati: “Ndavyemeye, ndakuvugira ku mwami.”

Batisheba agiye kuraba umwami Salomo ngo avugire Adoniya, umwami arahaguruka aja kumusanganira, aramwunamira, hanyuma yicara ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami. Amaze kwicara aca asaba ko bazana iyindi ntebe y’umugabekazi, Batisheba aca yicara i buryo bwiwe.
Batisheba abwira umwami ati: “Hari ico ngusaba kandi ndakwinginze ntunyankire.” Umwami ati: “Mbarira, urazi ko ntokwankira.”
Amubwira ati: “Emerera mwenewanyu Adoniya arongore Abishagi, umukobwa w’i Shunemu.”

Umwami Salomo abaza nyina ati: “Ni kubera iki ushaka ko Abishagi Umunyashunemukazi arongorwa na Adoniya? Ahubwo musabire n’ubwami na bwo! Ntuzi ko ari mukurwanje, kandi akaba afise Abiyatari umuherezi na Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya ku ruhande rwiwe!”
Umwami Salomo aca ararahira mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ati: “ Uhoraho azobimpanire, ndetse birengeje, nintica Adoniya kubera ivyo ansavye.
Uhoraho ni we yanyemeje, anyicarika ku ntebe ya data Dawidi, anshiraho nk’uko yabisezeranye. None rero ndarahiye Uhoraho ko Adoniya aja gupfa uwu musi nyene!”
Nuko umwami Salomo aca aha Benaya mwene Yehoyada itegeko ryo kumwica, Adoniya aca aricwa.

Umwami Salomo aca abarira Abiyatari umuherezi ati: “Subira i wanyu muri Anatoti. Wari ukwiye gupfa ariko sindakwica kuko wareruye Isandugu y’ Uhoraho Nyeninganji imbere ya data Dawidi, ukabana na we mu bihe bigoye vyose yaciyemwo.”
Nuko Salomo akura Abiyatari mu gikorwa c’umuherezi w’ Uhoraho , maze aba ashikije ijambo Uhoraho yavugiye i Shilo ku ruvyaro rwa Eli.

Yowabu ntiyari yifatanije na Abusalomu mu bugarariji bwiwe, ariko yari yifatanije na Adoniya mu kugarariza kwiwe. Yumvise ko Adoniya yapfuye, aca arirukanga mw’Ihema ry’ Uhoraho , afata amahembe y’igicaniro.
Umwami Salomo aramenya ko Yowabu yahungiye mw’ihema ry’ Uhoraho , kandi ko ari i ruhande y’igicaniro. Aca abarira Benaya mwene Yehoyada ati: “Genda umwice!”
Benaya aja mw’Ihema ry’ Uhoraho abarira Yowabu ati: “Umwami avuze ngo: ‘Sohoka!’ ” Ariko Yowabu yishura ati: “Eka sinsohoka, mpfira ngaha.” Benaya aca aragenda abarira umwami uko Yowabu yavuze.
Umwami aca abarira Benaya ati: “Bikore uko abivuze. Genda umwice, umuhambe, twe n’inzu ya data udukureko umuvumo w’amaraso y’abantu ata co bazira Yowabu yasheshe.

Uhoraho azomwishura ibihwanye n’ubwicanyi yagiriye abantu babiri bamusumvya ubugororotsi kandi bamusumvya n’ubutwari. Data ntiyigeze amenya ivy’urupfu rwa Abuneri mwene Neri umugabisha w’ingabo za Isirayeli, hamwe n’urwa Amasa mwene Yeteri umugabisha w’ingabo za Yuda.
Umuvumo w’amaraso yabo uzoje kuri Yowabu n’uruvyaro rwiwe ibihe vyose. Ariko amahoro y’ Uhoraho abe kuri Dawidi, ku ruvyaro rwiwe, ku nzu yiwe no ku ngoma yiwe ibihe vyose.”
Benaya mwene Yehoyada aca asubirayo yica Yowabu, amuhambisha mw’itongo ryiwe mu bugaragwa.
Umwami aca agira Benaya mwene Yehoyada umukuru w’ingabo, asubirira Yowabu. Abiyatari umuherezi na we asubirirwa na Sadoki umuherezi.
Umwami aca atumako Shimeyi amubwira ati: “Niwiyubakire inzu aha i Yerusalemu abe ari ho uba. Ariko ntuze wigere usohoka igisagara ngo hagire ahandi uja!
Nihagira aho uja ukarengana umwonga wa Kidironi, nta kabuza uzopfa, kandi amaraso yawe azoguharurweko.”
Shimeyi yishura umwami ati: “Ivyo uvuze ni vyiza. Nzokora ivyo umwami wanje ambariye.” Nuko Shimeyi aba i Yerusalemu ahamara igihe kirekire.
Ariko haciye imyaka itatu, abagurano babiri ba Shimeyi bahungira kwa Akishi mwene Mayaka umwami w’i Gati. Shimeyi amenye ko ari yo bari,
aca ashira amatandiko ku ndogoba, aja i Gati kubarondera. Abatoye, aca arabagarukana i Yerusalemu.
Maze Salomo yumva ko Shimeyi yavuye i Yerusalemu akaja i Gati akagaruka.

Umwami aca atumako Shimeyi amubaza ati: “Sinari nakurahije Uhoraho ndakubwira ko nihagira ahantu na hamwe uja ata kabuza uzokwicwa, nawe ukishura uti: ‘Ivyo uvuze ni vyiza, nzokora ico umwami wanje ambariye’?
None ni kuki utubahirije indahiro warahiriye imbere y’ Uhoraho , ntukurikize ivyo nagutegetse?”
Umwami arasubira amubwira ati: “Urazi mu mutima wawe ikibi wakoreye data Dawidi. None rero Uhoraho aguhore ikibi wakoze.
Ariko hahezagirwe umwami Salomo, ingoma ya Dawidi ihore ihangamye imbere y’ Uhoraho ibihe vyose.”
Umwami aca aha itegeko Benaya mwene Yehoyada, afata Shimeyi aja kumwica. Kuva ico gihe ingoma ya Salomo ica irakomera.

Umwami Salomo agirirana isezerano na Farawo umwami wa Egiputa, arongora n’umukobwa wiwe. Amuzana kuba mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, gushika ahejeje kwubaka ikirimba ciwe, Ingoro y’ Uhoraho hamwe n’inzitiro zikikuje Yerusalemu.
Ariko abantu bari bagishikanira ibimazi mu bibanza bitandukanye vyari vyaratoranijwe, kuko ata ngoro yari bwubakirwe Izina ry’ Uhoraho .
Salomo yarakunda Uhoraho , akagendera mu mategeko ya se Dawidi, kiretse ko we yatangiye ibimazi mu bindi bibanza vyatoranijwe, akahaturirira n’imibavu.
Umwami aja gutangira ibimazi i Gibeyoni, kuko ari ho hari hakuru kuruta ibindi bibanza vyose bitaramutse. Nuko Salomo aragenda ahatangira ibimazi vyo guturirwa igihumbi.
Akiri i Gibeyoni, Uhoraho yiyereka Salomo mw’ijoro ari mu ndoto, aramubwira ati: “Nsaba ico ushaka cose ndakiguha.”

Salomo arishura ati: “Wagiriye neza cane umusavyi wawe Dawidi ari we data, kuko yakubereye umwizigirwa, akakugororokera n’umutima utunganye. Kandi ukwo kugira neza waragukomeje, gushika aho umuha umuhungu wiwe yicara ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami uno musi.
None rero, Uhoraho Mana yanje, jewe umusavyi wawe wangize umwami mu kibanza ca data Dawidi. Ariko ndi umwana muto, sinzi uko ndabigenza.
Jewe umusavyi wawe ndi hagati mu bantu watoranije, ihanga rinini cane ritoharurika.
None rero mpa umutima w’ubwenge, kugira ngo nshobore kurongora ubwoko bwawe no gutandukanya iciza n’ikibi. Mbega none ni nde yoshobora kuganza ubu bwoko bwawe bwinshi bungana gutya?”
Imana inezerezwa cane n’uko Salomo ayisavye ikintu nk’ico,
maze imubwira iti: “Ko unsavye ivyo, utansavye kuramba canke ubutunzi, canke ngo unsabe kumara abansi bawe, ahubwo ukansaba ubwenge bwo kurongorana ubugorororotsi,
nzoguha ivyo unsavye. Nzoguha ubwenge n’umutima w’ubumenyi, ivyo ata wundi muntu n’umwe yigeze aronka imbere yawe, kandi ata n’uwundi azokwigera aronka inyuma yawe.
Hejuru y’ivyo, nzoguha n’ivyo utansavye: ubutunzi n’icubahiro, kugira ngo mu misi y’ukubaho kwawe ntihaze higere haboneka uwundi mwami azongana nawe.
Kandi niwagendera mu nzira zanje, ukubaha amategeko yanje nk’uko so Dawidi yabigize, nzogwiza imyaka yo kubaho kwawe.”

Salomo yikanguye, atahura ko yariko ararota. Aca asubira i Yerusalemu, ahagarara imbere y’Isandugu y’Isezerano y’Imana, ashikana ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’ivy’ishimwe. Hanyuma akoranya abatware biwe abagirira umusi mukuru.
Igihe kimwe abamaraya babiri baza imbere y’umwami bahagararaho.
Umwe muri bo avuga ati: “Mwami wanje, twe n’uwu mugore tuba mu nzu imwe. Igihe navyara umwana twari kumwe muri iyo nzu.
Haciye imisi itatu, na we avyara umwana. Twari twenyene, nta wundi yari ahari atari twebwe.
Ariko ijoro rimwe umwana wiwe arapfa kuko yamuryamyeko.
Aca aravyuka mw’ijoro, atwara umwana wanje nsinziriye. Amushira kw’ibere ryiwe, azana uwo rwiwe yapfuye amushira kw’ibere ryanje.
Bukeye, mvyutse ngo nonse umwana wanje, nsanga yapfuye. Ariko ndamwihweje neza mu gatondo habona, nsanga si wa mwana jewe nivyariye.”

Wa mugore wundi na we ati: “Uwo muzima ni we rwanje, uwo yapfuye ni we rwawe.” Umwe wa mbere arashishikara ati: “Haba na mba! Uwo yapfuye ni we rwawe, uwo muzima ni we ari uwanje.” Nuko babandanya guharirira imbere y’umwami.
Umwami aca avuga ati: “Umwe avuga ngo: ‘Umwana wanje ni uwu akomeye, uwawe ni uwu yapfuye,’ uwundi na we ati: ‘Urabesha, umwana wanje ni uwu ari muzima.’ ”
Umwami aca abandanya avuga ati: “Nimunzanira inkota.” Nuko barayimuzanira.
Aca atanga itegeko ati: “Fata uwo mwana muzima mumucemwo ibihimba bibiri, kimwe mugihe umwe, ikindi mugihe uwundi.”

Nyina w’uwo mwana muzima yumva ikibabarwe c’umwana wiwe, kuko yamukunda cane, aca arasemerera ati: “Ndakwinginze mwami wanje, muhe uwo mwana amutware, ntumwice!” Ariko uwundi ati: “Nta n’umwe muri twebwe amutwara. Nibamucemwo kubiri!”
Umwami aca avuga ati: “Uwo mwana muzima nimumuhe uwo mugore wa mbere. Ntimumwice; ni we nyina wiwe.”
Abisirayeli bose bumvise urubanza rwaciwe n’umwami, baramutangarira cane, kuko babonye ko afise ubwenge bwo guca imanza buva ku Mana.
Nuko umwami Salomo aganza muri Isirayeli.
Aba ni bo bari abatware biwe: Azariya mwene Sadoki umuherezi,
Elihorefu na Ahiya, bene Shisha, bari abanyamabanga, Yehoshafati mwene Ahiludi yari umwanditsi.
Benaya mwene Yehoyada yari umugabisha w’ingabo, Sadoki na Abiyatari bari abaherezi.
Azariya mwene Natani yari arongoye abakuru b’intara, Zabudi mwene Natani umuherezi yari umujenama w’umwami.
Ahishari yari ajejwe ikirimba, Adoniramu mwene Abuda na we yari ajejwe gukurikirana abahawe ibikorwa biruhisha.

Salomo yari afise kandi abatware cumi na babiri batwara intara cumi na zibiri za Isirayeli, ari na bo batanga ibikenewe i bwami. Umwe wese yari ajejwe gutanga ibikenewe vyose i bwami mu kwezi kumwe mu mwaka.
Abo na bo bari aba bakurikira: Beni-Huri yatwara intara y’imitumba ya Efurayimu.
Beni-Dekeri yatwara Makazi, Shayalubimu, Beti-Shemeshi na Eloni-Beti-Hanani.
Beni-Hasedi yatwara Aruboti (Soko na Heferi hose hari iwe).
Beni-Abinadabu yatwara Nefoti Dori (yarongoye Tafati umukobwa wa Salomo).
Bayana mwene Ahiludi yatwara Tanaki na Megido, na Beti-Shani yose hafi ya Zaretani musi ya Yezireyeli. Hava i Beti-Shani hagashika muri Abeli-Mehola, hakurya ya Yokimeyamu.

Beni-Geberi yatwara Ramoti Gileyadi harimwo igisagara ca Yayiro mwene Manase i Gileyadi, hamwe na Arugobu ho muri Bashani, hakabamwo n’ibisagara mirongo itandatu bininibinini bizitiye, bikagira ivyugazo vy’imyakaka ku marembo yavyo.
Ahinadabu mwene Ido yatwara Mahanayimu.
Ahimazi yatwara intara ya Nafutali. Uwo yari yarongoye Basemati, umukobwa wa Salomo.
Bayana mwene Hushayi yatwara intara ya Asheri no muri Bayaloti.
Yehoshafati mwene Paruwa yatwara intara ya Isakari,
Shimeyi mwene Ela yatwara intara ya Benyamini.
Geberi mwene Uri yatwara Gileyadi (Hahoze ari igihugu catwarwa na Sihoni umwami w’Abamori, hamwe n’igihugu catwarwa na Ogi umwami w’i Bashani). Ni we yari umutware w’iyo ntara wenyene.
Abantu bose b’i Buyuda na Isirayeli bangana n’umusenyi wo ku kiyaga, kandi bararya, baranywa, bakibera mu munezero.
Maze Salomo aganza ubwami bwose, kuva ku ruzi Efurate gushika ku ntara y’Abafilisitiya no ku rubibe rwa Egiputa. Ivyo bihugu vyose vyamushikaniye amashikanwa yo kumusaba impore ibihe vyose yabayeho.
Ivyo Salomo yari akeneye ku musi ku musi kugira ngo agaburire abo ku kirimba zari ingero koru mirongo itatu z’ifu isanzwe, ingero koru mirongo itandatu z’ifu iseye neza,
inka icumi zivyibushe zororewe mu ruhongore, inka mirongo ibiri zirisha ku musozi, intama ijana, udashizemwo impongo, ingeregere, ifumberi n’inkoko zivyibushe.
Salomo yatwara ubwami bwose bwo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, kuva i Tifusa gushika i Gaza, kandi ku mpande zose hari amahoro n’umutekano.

Mu bihe vyose Salomo yamaze, i Buyuda no muri Isirayeli hari amahoro n’umutekano, kuva mu ntara ya Dani mu buraruko ugashika mu ya Berisheba mu bumanuko, umuryango wose waba mu mizabibu no mu nsukoni zawo.
Salomo yari afise impongore ibihumbi bine z’ifarasi zakwega imikogote, akagira n’ifarasi ibihumbi cumi na bibiri.
Ku kwezi ku kwezi, abatwara intara, bama bazana ivyo umwami Salomo yaba akeneye, we ubwiwe hamwe n’abaja ku meza yiwe bose. Bama bitwararika kuraba ko ata kintu na kimwe kibuze.
Mbere barazana n’ingano zose zikenewe, hamwe rero n’ubwatsi bw’amafarasi akwega imikogote hamwe n’ayandi mafarasi ari mu mpongore.
Imana iha Salomo ubwenge bwinshi n’ugutahura bitagira urugero, bingana no kw’isesero ry’umusenyi wo ku kiyaga.
Ubwenge bwa Salomo bwasumba ubw’abandi bantu bose bo mu buseruko, ndetse n’ubw’Abanyegiputa bose.
Yari umunyabwenge gusumvya abantu bose, harimwo na Etani Umuzirahi. Yarasumvya na Hemani, Karukoli na Daruda bene Maholi, kandi agira ukumenyekana cane mu mahanga yari amukikuje.
Yaciye imigani ibihumbi bitatu, yandika n’indirimbo igihumbi na zitanu.
Yarasigura ivy’ibiti vyose ahereye kw’isederi ry’i Libani, agashitsa no kuri ezobu yimeza ku mpome z’amazu. Yarasigura kandi n’ivy’ibikoko n’ibiguruka, ibikwega inda hasi n’amafi.
Abantu bo mu mahanga yose baraza aho Salomo ari kugira ngo bumvirize ivy’ubwenge bwiwe, barungitswe n’abami bo kw’isi yose bumvise ivy’ubwenge bwiwe.

headings.text: Ivyashikanirwa Salomo ku musi ku musi

verses.text: Hiramu umwami w’i Tiro yumvise ko Salomo yimitswe ngo asubirire se Dawidi, amurungikira intumwa zo kumukeza, kuko yamye akundana na Dawidi.
Salomo na we arungikira ubutumwa Hiramu, buvuga buti:
“Urazi ko kubera intambara data Dawidi yamye agwana hirya no hino, atigeze ashobora kwubakira Ingoro izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe, gushika Uhoraho ashize abansi biwe musi y’ibirenge vyiwe.
Ariko ubu Uhoraho Imana yanje yampaye kuruhuka intambara ku mpande zose, nta mwansi nsigaranye, canke icago na kimwe.
None rero nagomba kwubakira Ingoro Izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yanje, nk’uko Uhoraho yabibwiye data Dawidi aho yavuga ati: ‘Umuhungu wawe nzogusubiriza ku ngoma ni we azokwubakira Ingoro izina ryanje.’

Nagomba rero ko wotanga itegeko kugira ngo bancire amasederi y’i Libani. Abantu bawe bazokorane n’abanje, kandi abantu bawe nzobahemba impembo yose wombwira. Urazi ko ata bandi bantu na bamwe bafise ubuhinga bwo kubaza ibiti nk’ubw’Abanyesidoni.”
Hiramu aronse ubutumwa bwa Salomo, aranezerwa cane avuga ati: “ Uhoraho nashimwe kuko uwu musi yahaye Dawidi umuhungu w’ubwenge ngo abe umwami w’ihanga rikomeye rya Isirayeli.”
Hiramu yishura Salomo ati: “Ubutumwa bwawe bwanshikiriye, kandi nzokora ivyo unsavye vyose, ndaguhe amasederi n’ubujwari ukeneye.

Abakozi banje bazobikura mu mitumba ya Libani babishikane ku kiyaga Mediterane, babitekere hamwe mu migwi, bimanuke vyoga gushika ku kibanza uzogena, hanyuma babitekurure kugira ngo ushobore kuvyikorera ubitware. Nawe uzoheza unyishure mu kumpa imfungurwa z’abantu bo ku kirimba canje.”
Nuko Hiramu aha Salomo ibiti vy’amasederi n’ubujwari yari akeneye vyose.

Salomo na we aca arungikira Hiramu ingero koru ibihumbi mirongo ibiri z’ingano zo gutunga abo mu rugo rwiwe, n’ingero batu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri z’amavuta meza cane ya Elayo. Uko ni ko Salomo yama abikorera Hiramu ku mwaka ku mwaka.
Uhoraho aha ubwenge Salomo, nk’uko yari yarabimusezeraniye. Hiramu na Salomo bagiriranira imigenderanire myiza, bagiranira n’amasezerano y’amahoro.
Umwami Salomo aca arondera abakozi ibihumbi mirongo itatu mu basanzwe baca ingero mu Bisirayeli.

Nuko arabarungika i Libani, bagenda barakuranwa ari ibihumbi cumicumi ku kwezi kugira ngo umuntu amare ukwezi kumwe i Libani, ayandi abiri na yo ayamare i muhira. Adoniramu ni we yari ajejwe abo bakozi.
Salomo yari afise abakozi ibihumbi mirongo indwi b’abikorezi, hamwe n’abandi ibihumbi mirongo umunani babaza amabuye ku misozi,
hamwe n’abandi ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana atatu bakoresha abandi, bagacungera ingene ibikorwa biriko biragenda.
Nuko Umwami ategeka ko bimba amabuye maninimanini ameze neza, ngo bayabaze kugira ngo abe umushinge bazodugirizako mu kwubaka iyo Ngoro.
Abahinga b’abubatsi ba Salomo n’aba Hiramu bategura imbaho n’amabuye yo kwubaka Ingoro, bafadikanije n’abo mu gisagara ca Gebali.

Mu mwaka ugira amajana ane na mirongo umunani Abisirayeli bavuye muri Egiputa, mu mwaka ugira kane Salomo agiye ku ngoma muri Isirayeli, mu kwezi kwa kabiri ari kwo kwitwa Zivu, Salomo atangura kwubakira Uhoraho Ingoro.

Ingoro umwami Salomo yubakiye Uhoraho yari ifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itandatu z’uburebure, ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’ubwaguke, n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itatu z’igihagararo.

Ibaraza ry’amaja imbere ry’inyubakwa nkuru y’Ingoro ryari rifise uburebure bungana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi n’ubwaguke bungana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri, co kimwe n’inyubakwa nkuru y’Ingoro.
Ku mpome z’iyo Ngoro Salomo yashizeko amadirisha matomato ariko ivyuma.
Ku mpande zayo na ho bahubatse utwumba tugerekeranye, tuyikikuje yose uhereye Ahera cane.

Utwumba two hasi twari dufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’ubwaguke, utwo hagati na two twari dufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitandatu z’ubwaguke, utwo hejuru na two twari dufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko indwi. Baza barasigaza aho imbaho zishikira ku ruhome, kugira ngo ntizinjizwe mu ruhome rw’imbere mu Ngoro.
Amabuye yo kwubaka iyo Ngoro bayabazira iyo bayimvye. Nta nyundo, incabiti canke ikindi cuma na kimwe cumvikana mu gihe co kuyubaka.
Ubwinjiriro bw’utwumba two hasi bwari ku ruhande rwo hepfo, hakaba n’ingazi zidugana ku twumba two hagati, hakaba n’iyava ku two hagati iduga ku two hejuru.
Ahejeje kwubaka iyo Ngoro, ayiha igisenge kigizwe n’inkingi hamwe n’imbaho vy’amasederi.
Yubaka n’utwumba dukikuje iyo Ngoro. Kamwekamwe kose kari gafise uburebure bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’amaduga, kagafatanywa n’ingoro hakoreshejwe inkingi z’amasederi.
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riza kuri Salomo,

riti: “Ku bw’iyi Ngoro wubatse, niwakurikiza ivyo nashinze ugashitsa amabwirizwa yanje, ukitondera ivyo nihanikiririje, hanyuma ugakurikiza ivyagezwe vyanje, nanje nzoshitsa ivyo nasezeraniye so Dawidi.
Nzobana n’Abisirayeli, kandi sinzokwigera mpeba ubwoko bwanje bwa Isirayeli.”
Nuko Salomo yubaka iyo Ngoro arayiheraheza neza.
Impome zose z’imbere azomekako imbaho z’amasederi, uhereye hasi ugashitsa ku gisenge, hasi na ho ahasasa imbaho z’akajwari.

Ayiha icumba c’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’uburebure, na co nyene acomekamwo imbaho z’amasederi, uhereye hasi ugashitsa ku gisenge; maze ico cumba kirategurwa kugira ngo kibe Ahera Cane h’iyo Ngoro.
Ahasigaye h’iyo Ngoro ari co cumba c’imbere y’Ahera cane hari hafise uburebure bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ine uhereye ku cumba c’Ahera cane.
Impome zaho zari zometseko imbaho z’amasederi zishushanijeko uturende hamwe n’udushurwe dusambuye. Ahantu hose hari hapfutswe n’imbaho, nta buye ryaboneka.
Salomo ategura icumba c’imbere mu Ngoro aho gutereka Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho .

Ico cumba carangana impande zose: cari gifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’uburebure bw’amakika, ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’ubwaguke, n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’uburebure bw’amaduga. Acomekamwo inzahabu ihinguwe neza, igicaniro na co acomekako imbaho z’amasederi.
Ahasigaye hose ho muri iyo ngoro ahomekako inzahabu ihinguwe neza, atambika n’iminyororo y’inzahabu ku bwinjiriro bw’Ahera cane.
Nuko imbere mu Ngoro hose ahomeka inzahabu, ayomeka no ku gicaniro c’Ahera cane.
Mu cumba co haruguru ashirayo abakerubi babiri babajwe mu giti c’umwelayo. Umwe wese yari afise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko icumi z’uburebure bw’amaduga.
Ibaba rimwerimwe ry’umukerubi ryari rifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’amakika; kuva kw’isunwa rimwe ry’ibaba ugashika ku ry’irindi hari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko icumi.
Umukerubi wa kabiri na we nyene yari afise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko icumi. Abo bakerubi barangana kandi bagasa hose.
Uburebure bw’amaduga bwabo bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko icumi.
Ashira abo bakerubi Ahera Cane, amababa yabo aramvuye, iry’umwe rikora ku ruhome rumwe rw’ico cumba, irindi rikora ku rundi, ayandi na yo agahurira hagati na hagati y’ico cumba.
Abo bakerubi na bo nyene abomekako inzahabu.
Ku mpome zose, iz’icumba c’imbere n’iz’icumba c’amaja hanze ahakorogoshoramwo udushushanyo tw’abakerubi, ibigazi n’amashurwe asambuye.
Hasi muri ivyo vyumba bibiri na ho nyene ahomeka inzahabu.
Mu bwinjiriro buja mu cumba c’imbere yahashize imiryango ibajwe mu biti vy’imyelayo vyo mw’ishamba kandi ibishimaryango n’umwaro wavyo mu bwaguke vyangana n’ica gatanu c’uruhome rwose.
Kuri izo mbaho zibiri z’imyelayo akorogoshoramwo uduhushanyo tw’abakerubi, ibigazi n’amashurwe asambuye, abo bakerubi n’ibigazi aca avyomekako inzahabu.
Yongera akora n’umuryango mu mbaho z’imyelayo wo kwugara ku bwinjiriro bw’Ingoro.
Akora n’inzugi zibiri mu bujwari, zihurira hagati, rumwe barwuguruye rukaja i bubamfu urundi rukaja i buryo.
Aca akorogoshora kuri izo nzugi udushushanyo tw’abakerubi, ibigazi hamwe n’amashurwe asambuye, yongera azomekako inzahabu.
Urugo rw’iyo nyubakwa rwari rwubatswe n’imirongo itatu y’amabuye maninimanini, hamwe n’umurongo umwe w’ibiti vy’amasederi bibajwe.
Umushinge w’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho wubatswe mu mwaka ugira kane, mu kwezi kwa Zivu.
Mu mwaka ugira cumi na kabiri, mu kwezi kwawo kwa Buli ari kwo kw’umunani, iyo Ngoro yari ihejeje kwubakwa neza, isozerewe nk’uko vyari vyarategekanijwe. Yubatswe mu myaka indwi.
Maze Salomo yubaka ikirimba ciwe, amara imyaka cumi n’itatu kugira ngo agiheze.

Imwe mu nyubakwa yubatse yitwa Ikirimba citiriwe Ishamba rya Libani. Yari ifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana z’uburebure, mirongo itanu z’ubwaguke, na mirongo itatu z’igihagararo. Yari ifise imirongo ine y’inkingi z’amasederi zitambitseko imyaro y’amasederi nyene.
Igisenge cari gikozwe mu biti vy’amasederi nyene bitambitswe kuri ya myaro uko yari cumicumi n’itanu mu murogo umwe wose.
Uruhome rumwerumwe rwose rwaba rufise imirongo itatu y’amadirisha,
Inzugi n’amadirisha vyayo vyose vyari bifise uburebure n’ubwaguke bingana, vyari bitatubitatu birabana.

Yubaka n’ibaraza rifise inkingi, uburebure bwaryo bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu, ubwaguke na bwo bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itatu, kandi imbere yaryo ahubaka akandi kabaraza kari gapfutswe n’igisenge gifashwe n’inkingi.
Yubaka n’ikindi cumba kinini kirimwo intebe y’ubwami, ari co cumba c’ubucamanza. Ni ho Salomo yicara aca imanza, hari hometsweko imbaho z’amasederi kuva hasi gushika hejuru.
Ingoro nyezina yabamwo yari inyuma y’aho, hose hari hubatswe co kimwe. Yongera yubakira ingoro nk’iyo nyene umukobwa wa Farawo yarongoye.

Izo nyubakwa zose, kuva hasi gushika hejuru zari zubatswe n’amabuye maninimanini, y’agaciro, afise impande ziringanirije ku mfuruka, abajwe n’umusumeno ku mpande zose hanyuma agasenwa. Bayubakisha kuva ku mushinge gushika aho bayimanikira, no kuva ku nzu y’imbere ugashitsa ku y’inyuma.
Umushinge wari ugizwe n’amabuye maninimanini kandi mezameza. Amwe muri ayo yaba afise nk’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi canke umunani z’uburebure bw’amakika.
Hejuru y’ayo hajako amabuye yatoranijwe mezameza, abaje neza, hamwe n’ibiti vy’amasederi bibaje.
Ikirimba cari gikikujwe n’urugo rugizwe n’imirongo itatu y’amabuye, agakurikirwa n’umurongo umwe w’ibiti vy’amasederi bibaje, bimera nk’uko babigenjeje ku rugo rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho n’urubaraza rwayo.
Umwami Salomo atumako umuntu w’i Tiro yitwa Hiramu,

yari umuntu azi ubuhinga bwinshi bwo gucura ibintu mu mwakaka. Nyina wiwe yari Umwisirayeli wo mu muryango wa Nafutali, se na we yari Umunyetiro w’umuhinga mu bijanye no gukora ibintu mu mwakaka. Nuko araza akorera umwami Salomo ibikorwa amuhaye.
Hiramu acura inkingi zibiri mu mwakaka, z’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi n’umunani z’uburebure bw’igihagararo, n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi na zibiri z’inkikuro.
Ashongesha umwakaka awukoramwo imifuniko ibiri yo gushira ku mitwe y’izo nkingi. Umwe wose wari ufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’uburebure bw’igihagararo.
Akora n’utundi dusharizo mu mwakaka, tumeze nk’urusobangane rw’insenga, two gushariza iyo mifuniko; umufuniko wose awushirako utwo dusharizo indwi tumeze nk’insenga.
Acura n’ibisharizo bimeze nk’amakomamanga, abimanika kuri bimwe bimeze nk’insenga, agira imirongo ibiri yavyo ikikuza za nkingi, agira gutyo nyene no ku myashi.
Imifuniko yo ku nkingi zo mw’ibaraza yari ikozwe mw’ishusho y’amashurwe y’amarebe, ikagira uburebure bw’igihagararo bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zine.
Hejuru kuri iyo mifuniko, aho ihurira n’inkingi, ahashira ya makomamanga amajana abiri, iri ku mirongo, iyikikuje.
Ahagarika za nkingi mw’ibaraza ry’Ingoro; inkingi y’amaja mu bumanuko ayita Yakini, iy’amaja mu buraruko, ayita Bowazi.
Ku mitwe ya ya mifuniko hari hashushanijeko amashurwe y’amarebe.

Yongera akoresha ibesani nini ayita ikiyaga, bayikora ari umuzingi mu butare bw’umwakaka. Ubwaguke bwayo ku rubiga, uva ku ruhande rumwe uja ku rundi uciye hagati, bwangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi, kandi yari ifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’igihagararo. Uburebure bw’uwo muzingi na wo uwuzungurutse bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itatu.

Musi y’urubiga, hari ibisharizo vy’ibibumbano biyikikuje bishushanije nk’udukunga. Vyakikuza urubiga ari cumicumi ku ngero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe, bikaba bitondetse ku mirongo ibiri ibangabanganye. Ivyo bisharizo vyari vyabumbanywe n’iyo besani.

Iyo besani yari ihagaze ku bibumbano vy’impfizi cumi na zibiri zicuzwe mu butare bw’umwakaka, zitatu zikaraba mu buraruko, zitatu mu burengero, izindi zitatu mu bumanuko hamwe n’izindi zitatu zaraba mu buseruko. Iyo besani bita ikiyaga, yari iteretse hejuru kuri ivyo bibumbano vy’izo mpfizi, maze ibice vy’inyuma vyazo bikaraba hagati musi y’ico kiyaga.
Cari gifise intimbatimba ingana n’ikiganza c’umuntu, kandi urubiga rwaco rwari rumeze nk’urw’igikombe, nk’ishurwe ry’ikirungu risambuye. Cashobora kwuzuzwa n’ingero batu ibihumbi bibiri.

Acura n’ibitereko cumi mu mwakaka; kimwekimwe cose cari gifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zine z’uburebure, ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zine z’ubwaguke hamwe n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitatu z’igihagararo.
Ivyo bitereko vyari bicuzwe gutya: vyari bifise imiringa ibase ifashe ku mbiga.
Kuri iyo miringa hari hashushanijweko intare, amashuri hamwe n’abakerubi, kandi kuri izo mbiga musi no hejuru y’ivyo bishushanijeko, hari hacuriyeko utugenegene twenena.

Igitereko cose cari gifise amapine ane acuzwe mu mwakaka, kandi ivyuma bifashe ayo mapine na vyo nyene vyari bicuzwe mu mwakaka: Mu mfuruka zaco uko ari zine hariho ibishigikizo vyo gushigikira ibesani, na vyo bikaba vyari bicuzwe mu mwakaka, uruhande rwose rusharijwe n’utugenegene dusobanganije.

Igitereko kimwekimwe cose cari gifise amapine ane acuzwe mu mwakaka hamwe n’ibiyafatanya, kikagira n’imbiga y’ubwaguke bw’ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe, n’ibiyishigikiye bipima ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe n’igice y’uburebure. Hariho ikimeze nk’umubehe gitoya gifashwe na ya mbiga. Vya bishigikizo na ya mbiga vyari bisharijwe n’utugenegene tw’amashurwe tubikorogoshoweko. Impande zine z’igitereko zari ziringaniye,
ya mapine n’ibiyafatanije bikaba musi yaco. Amapine yapima ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe n’igice y’uburebure,
afatanijwe nk’ay’umukogote. Ivyuma vyose bifatanye n’ayo mapine vyari bicuzwe mu mwakaka.
Igitereko cose cari gicuranywe n’ivyo gufata mu kugiterura, biri ku mfuruka zose.
Hejuru ku gitereko hariko ikimeze nk’ingata; uburebure bw’igihagararo bwaco bwari igice c’ingero y’igice c’ukuboko. Ibishigikizo hamwe n’utuntu tubase two kuri co vyari bicuranywe na co.

Kuri ivyo bishigikizo, ku mpande zavyo zibase, no kuri twa tuntu tubase nyene yahakorogoshoyemwo udushushanyo tw’abakerubi, intare hamwe n’ibigazi, uko hagenda haringaniye, hamwe n’udushushanyo tw’amashurwe asobanganije ku mpande ziringaniye zose.
Uko ni ko yacuze ivyo bitereko cumi. Vyacuriwe mw’iforoma imwe, kandi vyose vyarasa bikongera bikangana.
Yongera acura amabesani cumi mu mwakaka, imwimwe yose yuzuzwa n’ingero batu mirongo ine, kandi imwimwe yose yari ifise ubwaguke bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zine.

Ibitereko bitanu abitereka ku ruhande rw’i buryo rw’Ingoro, ibindi bitanu abishira ku ruhande rw’i bubamfu, ya besani nini yitwa Ikiyaga, ayishira ku ruhande rwo hepfo, ku mfuruka iherereye mu buseruko.
Huramu yarakoze kandi inkono, ivyaruzo, hamwe n’ibikombe vyo gusuka. Maze Huramu aheraheza ico gikorwa c’umwami Salomo yari yatanguye mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho :
za nkingi zibiri; ya myashi ibiri imeze nk’ibikombe yo ku mutwe w’izo nkingi; ya migufu ibiri isobekeranye yo gushariza iyo myashi ibumbwe bwa bikombe biri ku mitwe y’izo nkingi;
vya bicurano bisa n’amakomamanga amajana ane yo kuri ya migufu ibiri; imirongo ibiri y’ibisa n’amakomamanga ku mugufu umwumwe usharije ya myashi iri ku mitwe ya za nkingi;
ivyo guterekako ya mabesani cumi hamwe n’ayo mabesani cumi nyene;
ca kiyaga na vya bibumbano vy’amashuri cumi n’abiri cari giteretseko;
za nkono, vya vyaruzo hamwe n’ibikombe. Ivyo bikoresho vyose Huramu yacuriye umwami Salomo ku bw’iyo Ngoro y’ Uhoraho yabicuze mu butare bw’umwakaka uhinguwe neza.
Umwami ategeka ko bifyaturirwa mu maforoma y’ibumba mu kiyaya ca Yorodani hagati ya Sukoti na Zaretani.
Salomo ntiyiriwe arapima ivyo bintu yakoresheje vyose; vyari vyinshi ku buryo igipimo c’ubutare bw’umwakaka bwakoreshejwe kitashobora kumenyekana.
Salomo yongera akora ibikoresho vyose vyari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho : igicaniro c’inzahabu, imeza y’inzahabu yo gushirako ya mikate ihezagiye,
vya biterekwako amatara vy’inzahabu ihinguwe neza: bitanu i buryo na bitanu i bubamfu, imbere y’Ahera Cane; ya mashurwe acuzwe mu nzahabu, amatara n’ivyo kuyora umunyota vyari bikozwe mu nzahabu;
amabesani, imbugita, utubakure, ibikombe n’udusahani tw’umunyota bicuzwe mu nzahabu ihinguye neza; n’amapata y’inzugi z’Ahera Cane n’ay’inzugi z’icumba gikuru c’Ingoro, yose akozwe mu nzahabu.

Igikorwa cose Salomo yakoreye Ingoro y’ Uhoraho giheze, aca yinjiza ibintu vyose se Dawidi yari yaragize inyegu y’ Uhoraho : ifeza, inzahabu n’ibindi bikoresho, abishira mu bubiko bw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Nuko umwami Salomo aca atumako abakuru b’Abisirayeli, abatware b’imiryango bose n’abaserukira amazu y’Abisirayeli, bakoranira i Yerusalemu kugira ngo bazane Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho , bayikure aho yari iri i Siyoni mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, bayijane mu kibanza gishasha kiri muri iyo Ngoro.
Abisirayeli bose bakoranira imbere y’umwami Salomo ku musi mukuru w’insago, hari mu kwezi kw’indwi ari kwo Etanimu.
Abakuru bose b’Abisirayeli bamaze gushika, abaherezi baterura ya sandugu barayidugana,
badugana Isandugu y’ Uhoraho n’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, badugana n’ibikoresho vyose vyakoreshwa muri ryo.
Umwami Salomo n’ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli bari bakoraniye hamwe na we bari imbere y’iyo sandugu, batanga ibimazi vyinshi vy’intama n’inka bitashoboye kwandikwa canke ngo biharurwe.
Abo baherezi baca bajana iyo Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho aho yateguriwe mu gice c’imbere mu Ngoro, ari ho hitwa Ahera Cane, baca bayishira musi y’amababa ya ba bakerubi.
Abo bakerubi bari bashanje amababa hejuru y’aho iyo sandugu yari iri, agapfuka isandugu hamwe n’imyamba bayireruza.
Iyo myamba yari miremire ku buryo umuntu ari Ahera yashobora kubona aho igarukira. Ariko umuntu atarashika Ahera, ntivyashoboka ko ayibona; kandi iracariho gushika n’uwu musi.
Nta kindi kintu cari muri iyo sandugu kiretse vya bisate vy’amabuye Mose yashiramwo ari i Horebu, aho Uhoraho yagiraniye isezerano n’Abisirayeli bamaze kuva muri Egiputa.
Abaherezi bamaze gusohoka bakava muri ico cumba c’Ahera, igicu cakaka kiraza cuzura mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Abaherezi ntibaba bagishobora gukora igikorwa cabo kubera ico gicu, kuko ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bwari bwuzuye Ingoro y’Uhoraho.
Maze Salomo avuga ati: “Ewe Uhoraho , wavuze ko uba mu gicu c’umwijima w’umuzitanya.
Ariko jewe nakwubakiye vy’ukuri Ingoro y’igitangaza, ikibanza uzokwiberamwo ibihe vyose.”
Ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli rigihagaze ngaho, umwami arahindukira arabahezagira.
Maze avuga ati: “ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, ahimbazwe, we ashikije n’amaboko yiwe ivyo yari yarasezeraniye data Dawidi n’akanwa kiwe, aho yavuga ati:

‘Uhereye umusi nakuriye ubwoko bwanje bw’Abisirayeli muri Egiputa, sinigeze ntoranya igisagara na kimwe co mu miryango ya Isirayeli ngo cubakwemwo Ingoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, ariko natoranije Dawidi kugira ngo abe ari we aganza abantu banje b’Abisirayeli.’
Data Dawidi yari afise ku mutima umugambi wo kwubakira Ingoro izina ry’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli.
Ariko Uhoraho amubwira ati: ‘Wagize neza kwiyumvira kwubakira Ingoro izina ryanje,
ariko si wewe uzoyubaka. Umuhungu wawe, uwo wivyariye, ni we azokwubakira Ingoro izina ryanje.’

Uhoraho yazigamye isezerano ryiwe. Yansubije mu gishingo ca data Dawidi; none ubu nicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami bwa Isirayeli, nk’uko Uhoraho yabisezeranye, kandi nanje nubatse Ingoro yo guhesha icubahiro izina ry’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli.
Nateguye ikibanza muri yo co kubikamwo ya sandugu, irimwo rya sezerano Uhoraho yagiranye na ba sogokuruza igihe yabakura muri Egiputa.”
Maze Salomo ahagarara imbere y’igicaniro c’ Uhoraho n’imbere y’ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli agorora amaboko ayerekeje mw’ijuru.
Nuko aravuga ati: “Ewe Uhoraho Mana ya Isirayeli, nta yindi Mana ihwanye nawe mw’ijuru hejuru no mw’isi hasi, wewe uzigama isezerano wagiriye abasavyi bawe, bagukurikira n’imitima yabo yose.
Wazigamye isezerano wagiriye data Dawidi umusavyi wawe, urisezeranishije akanwa kawe, none uwu musi urishikishije amaboko yawe.

None rero Uhoraho , Mana ya Isirayeli, zigamira umusavyi wawe Dawidi ari we data, isezerano wamugiriye, aho wavuga uti: ‘Mu ruvyaro rwawe, ntihazokwigera habura uwuba ku ngoma ya Isirayeli, nirwagendera mu Vyagezwe vyanje nk’uko wabigendeyemwo.’
None rero Mana ya Isirayeli, shitsa amasezerano wasezeraniye data Dawidi umusavyi wawe.
Ariko none vy’ukuri Imana izoba kw’isi? Ko amajuru, mbere n’amajuru asumba ayandi, udashobora kuyakwirwamwo, mbe ndareka iyi Ngoro nubatse!
Ariko wumvirize ugusenga n’ukwinginga kwanje, Uhoraho Mana yanje. Wumve ugutakamba n’ugusenga kw’umusavyi wawe ari imbere yawe uwu musi.
Inyonga zawe zize zame ziri kuri iyi Ngoro ijoro n’umurango, aha hantu wavuzeko uti: ‘Izina ryanje rizokwama aha.’ Uzokwame wumva amasengesho umusavyi wawe azosengera hano hantu.
Uze wumvirize ukwinginga kw’umusavyi wawe n’ukw’abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli nibasenga batumbereye iyi ngoro. Uze ubumvirize uri mw’ijuru, aho uba, kandi niwabumva, ubaharire.
Umuntu niyagirira nabi mugenziwe maze bigasabwa ko bamurahiza ko atabikoze, akaza akarahirira imbere y’igicaniro cawe kiri muri iyi Ngoro,
uze uvyumve uri mw’ijuru ucire urubanza abantu bawe. Uwakoze ikibi atsindwe, ivyo yakoze bimusubire ku mutwe kandi hatsinde uwutacumuye, umwerekane kandi bimenyekane ko ata kimwagira.
Abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli nibatsindwa n’abansi babo kuko bagucumuyeko maze bagahindukira bagahimbaza izina ryawe, bagasenga binginga imbere yawe bari muri iyi Ngoro,
uzobumve uri mw’ijuru, uharire icaha c’abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli, ubagarukane mu gihugu wahaye ba sekuruza.
Ijuru niryugarwa imvura ntigwe kuko abantu bawe bagucumuyeko, maze bagasenga batumbereye aha hantu bagahimbaza izina ryawe, bagahindukira bakava mu caha cabo, umaze kubateza ivyago,
uze ubumve uri mw’ijuru, uharire icaha c’abasavyi bawe, ari bo bwoko bwawe bw’Abisirayeli. Uze ubigishe inzira zawe, maze urekurire imvura mu gihugu wahaye abantu bawe nk’umugabane.

Ikigoyi canke ikiza nivyatera mu gihugu, canke akaranda canke ururyi, inzige canke ibihori, canke umwansi wabo akabugariza mu gisagara kimwe mu vyo babamwo, ikiza ico ari co cose canke ingwara iyo ari yo yose nivyabashikako,
maze hakagira na bamwe bo mu Bisirayeli basenga ku bw’imibabaro yo mu mitima yabo, bakarabisha ibiganza vyabo kuri iyi Ngoro,
nawe uze wumve uri mw’ijuru, aho wibera. Uze ubaharire kandi ugire ico ukoze, ugirire umuntu wese ibihwanye n’ivyo yakoze, kuko uzi imitima yabo: ni wewe wenyene uzi imitima y’abana b’abantu bose.
Ni ho bazogutinya imisi yose bazoba mu gihugu wahaye ba sogokuruza.
Mbere n’aho yoba umunyamahanga atari uwo mu bwoko bwawe bw’Abisirayeli, ariko akaza avuye mu gihugu ca kure ku bw’izina ryawe,
kuko bazokwumva ivy’izina ryawe rihambaye n’ukuboko kwawe kw’inkomezi kandi kugoroye; niyaza akagusenga atumbereye iyi Ngoro,

uze umwumve uri mw’ijuru, aho uba, ukorere uwo munyamahanga ico azoba agusavye cose, kugira ngo amahanga yose yo kw’isi amenye izina ryawe akwubahe, nk’uko abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli bakora, kandi bamenye ko iyi Ngoro nubatse yitirirwa izina ryawe.
Abantu bawe nibaja mu ntambara kugwanya abansi babo, aho uzobarungika hose, maze bagasenga Uhoraho batumbereye iki gisagara watoranije n’iyi Ngoro nubakiye izina ryawe;
nuko uze wumve ugusenga kwabo no kwinginga kwabo uri mw’ijuru, ubatabare.

Nibaramuka bagucumuyeko, kuko ata muntu adacumura, hanyuma uburake bwawe bukabaziriringira, maze ukabarekurira mu maboko y’abansi babo bakabatwara nk’inyagano mu bihugu vyabo, vyaba ivya hafi canke ivya kure;

maze nibahindukira mu mitima yabo bari mu gihugu bajanywemwo nk’inyagano, bakihana bakagusaba imbabazi bari muri ico gihugu c’ababanyaze bakavuga bati: ‘twaracumuye, twakoze nabi, twakoze ivyo kwankwa urunuka,’

maze bakagaruka kuri wewe n’imitima yabo yose n’imishaha yabo yose, bari mu gihugu c’abansi babo babagize inyagano, hanyuma bagasenga baraba mu gihugu wahaye ba sekuruza babo, no ku gisagara watoranije hamwe no kuri iyi Ngoro nubakiye izina ryawe,
nuko uri mw’ijuru, aho uba, uze wumve ugusenga kwabo n’ugutakamba kwabo, uheze ubagwanirire.
Uheze uharire abantu bawe, bagucumuyeko, ubaharire ibibi vyose bazoba bakoze, maze utume ababatwaye babagirira impuhwe,
kuko ari ubwoko bwawe, inyegu yawe, abo wakuye muri Egiputa, rya tanure rivugutira ivyuma bigashonga.
Niwumve ugusenga kwanje jewe umusavyi wawe, n’ukwinginga kw’ubwoko bwawe bwa Isirayeli, kandi uzokwame ubumva igihe cose bazoba bagutakambiye.
Kuko wabatoranije mu mahanga yose yo kw’isi ukabagira inyegu yawe, nk’uko wabivugiye mu kanwa k’umusavyi wawe Mose igihe wakura ba sogokuruza bacu muri Egiputa, ewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji.”
Salomo ahejeje gusenga no kwinginga Uhoraho gutyo, aca arahaguruka ava imbere y’igicaniro aho yari apfukamye, ashanje amaboko ayarabishije kw’ijuru.
Ahezagira ikoraniro ryose rya Isirayeli, avuga n’ijwi rirenga ati:
“ Uhoraho nashimwe, we yahaye akaruhuko ubwoko bwiwe bwa Isirayeli nk’uko yari yarabisezeranye. Nta sezerano na rimwe yasezeranye aciye ku musavyi wiwe Mose ritashitse.
Uhoraho Imana yacu azobana natwe nk’uko yabanye na ba sogokuruza bacu, ntazokwigera aduta, ntazokwigera aduheba.
Niyigarurire imitima yacu, kugira ngo dushobore kugendera mu mabwirizwa, amategeko n’ivyo yihanikiririje ba sogokuruza bacu.

Kandi aya majambo yanje y’amasengesho nasengeye imbere y’ Uhoraho , aze yame imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yacu ijoro n’umurango, kugira ngo aze yishure umusavyi wiwe n’ubwoko bwiwe bwa Isirayeli ibihwanye n’ivyo bazoba bakeneye ku musi ku musi,
kugira ngo abo kw’isi bose bamenye ko Uhoraho ari Imana, kandi ko ata yindi Mana iriho.
Imitima yanyu na yo niyegurirwe rwose Uhoraho Imana yacu, muzokwame mugendera mu mategeko no mu mabwirizwa yayo, nk’uko mubigenderamwo uno musi.”
Nuko umwami n’Abisirayeli bose bashikanira ibimazi Uhoraho .

Salomo ashikanira Uhoraho amashikanwa y’ishimwe agizwe n’impfizi ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri n’intama ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri. Nuko umwami n’Abisirayeli bose bashikiriza Uhoraho iyo Ngoro.

Uwo musi nyene, umwami ashikiriza Uhoraho ikibanza kiri imbere y’Ingoro, ahatangira n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa, ivy’ifu hamwe n’ivy’ishimwe, kuko igicaniro c’umwakaka cari imbere y’ Uhoraho cari gito cane, kitashobora gukwirwako ibimazi vyo guturirwa, ivy’ifu n’ivy’ishimwe.

Nuko umwami Salomo ari kumwe n’Abisirayeli bose bahimbaza uwo musi mukuru. Hari hakoraniye abantu isinzi bari baje bava kure cane mu buraruko i Lebo-Hamati gushika epfo kure mu bumanuko ku kagezi ka Egiputa. Bamara imisi indwi bahimbaza uwo musi mukuru w’ Uhoraho Imana yacu, biyongera iyindi misi indwi, yose hamwe iba cumi n’ine.

Ku musi ugira umunani umwami Salomo asezera abantu, basubira iwabo. Na bo bahezagira umwami, bataha banezerewe cane, imitima yabo inezerejwe n’ivyo Uhoraho yakoreye umusavyi wayo Dawidi n’abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Salomo ahejeje kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho n’ikirimba c’umwami, agashika no ku vyo yari yaripfuje gukora,
Uhoraho amwiyereka ubugira kabiri, nka kumwe yari yaramwiyerekeye i Gibeyoni.
Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Numvise ugusenga n’ukwinginga kwawe, maze ndobanura iyi Ngoro wubatse, ngo yitirirwe izina ryanje ibihe bidashira. Amaso yanje n’umutima wanje bizokwama kuri yo.
Nawe niwagendera imbere yanje mu bwizigirwa n’umutima utunganye no mu bugororotsi nk’uko so Dawidi yabigira, ugakora ivyo nagutegetse vyose, ugakurikiza amategeko n’amabwirizwa yanje;
nzokomeza intebe yawe y’ubwami mu Bisirayeli ibihe vyose, nk’uko nasezeraniye so Dawidi aho navuga nti: ‘Mu ruvyaro rwawe ntihazokwigera habura uwuganza ku ngoma y’Abisirayeli.’
Ariko wewe n’uruvyaro rwawe nimwamvako, mugata amategeko n’amabwirizwa nabahaye, mukaja gukorera izindi mana mukazisenga;
nanje nzorandura Abisirayeli mu gihugu nabahaye, n’iyi Ngoro neguriye izina ryanje nzoyishibura imve mu maso. Ihanga rya Isirayeli nzorigira iciro ry’imigani mu yandi mahanga.
Kandi naho iyi Ngoro yari iteye igomwe, abazoyica i ruhande bazogira ubwoba batangare, hanyuma bitwengere bavuga bati: ‘Ni igiki catumye Uhoraho agirira atya iki gihugu n’iyi Ngoro?’

Abantu bazobishura bati: ‘Ni ukubera bataye Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza yabakuye muri Egiputa, bagahindukirira izindi mana, bakazisenga kandi bakazikorera; ni co gituma Uhoraho yabateje ivyo vyago vyose.’ ”
Haheze imyaka mirongo ibiri, iyo Salomo yubatsemwo izo nyubakwa zibiri ari zo Ngoro y’ Uhoraho n’ikirimba c’umwami,
umwami Salomo aca aha Hiramu umwami w’i Tiro ibisagara mirongo ibiri vy’i Galilaya, kuko Hiramu ari we yamuhaye amasederi n’ubujwari hamwe n’inzahabu yari akeneye.
Ariko Hiramu avuye i Tiro akaja kuraba ivyo bisagara Salomo yamuhaye, ntivyamuhimbara.
Aramubaza ati: “Ibi ni ibisagara nyabaki umpaye ga mugenzi?” Aca avyita intara ya Kabuli, ni ko hitwa gushika n’ubu.
Hiramu yari yahaye umwami italanto ijana na mirongo ibiri z’inzahabu.

Ibi bikurikira ni vyo vyerekana ibikorwa biruhisha umwami Salomo yategekanije kugira ngo ashobore kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , ikirimba ciwe, impome zishigikira inkombe, inzitiro za Yerusalemu, hamwe n’ibisagara Hazori Megido na Gezeri.
Farawo umwami wa Egiputa yari yarateye igisagara ca Gezeri, aragifata, aragiturira. Yica Abanyakanani bakibamwo, maze agiha umukobwa wiwe nk’ingabire yo ku bukwe bwiwe igihe yarongorwa na Salomo.
Salomo aca asubiramwo kwubaka Gezeri, yubaka n’ibisagara vy’epfo ya Beti-Horoni,
Bayalati na Tadumori mu ntara iri mu gihugu ciwe mu bugaragwa,
hamwe n’ibisagara vyose vy’ububiko, n’ivy’imikogote n’amafarasi yiwe; ivyo yipfuje vyose kwubaka i Yerusalemu, i Libani no mu gihugu cose aho yaganza.
Hari hakiriho amasigarira y’Abamori, Abaheti, Abaperizi, Abahiwi n’Abayebusi. Abo bo ntibari Abisirayeli.

Yari amoko Abisirayeli batashoboye kurandura, yakomoka ku mahanga yahora aba muri ico gihugu. Nuko Salomo aca afata abo bantu bose abagira abagurano, abashingira ibikebere ngo bakore ibikorwa vy’agahato, nk’uko biri kugeza n’uwu musi.
Ariko Salomo nta Mwisirayeli n’umwe yagize umugurano, ahubwo yabagize abo kugwana: abatware, intwazangabo, abasoda bakurubakuru, abagwanira ku mikogote n’abarongozi babo.
Abo batware bari bajejwe ibikorwa vya Salomo, kandi amajana atanu na mirongo itanu bo muri bo bagakurikirana abantu bari ku bikorwa vy’umwami.
Umukobwa wa Farawo amaze kuva mu Gisagara ca Dawidi akaja mu ngoro Salomo yamwubakiye, Salomo yaciye yubaka impome zikingira inyubakwa.

Salomo yama atanga gatatu ku mwaka ibimazi bituriwe n’ibimazi vy’ishimwe, akabitangira ku gicaniro yubakiye Uhoraho , akabiturirana n’ibimota neza imbere y’ Uhoraho . Uko ni ko yatunganije ibikorwa vyo muri iyo Ngoro.
Umwami Salomo yongera akora amato, ayakorera ahitwa Eziyoni Geberi, ikivuko co hafi ya Elati muri Edomu, ku nkengera y’Ikiyaga Gitukura.
Maze Hiramu arungika abahinga bo gutwara ubwato ngo bakorane n’abakozi ba Salomo.
Nuko barasoza bashika muri Ofiru, bagaruka bazanye italanto amajana ane na mirongo ibiri z’inzahabu bazishikiriza umwami Salomo.
Umwamikazi w’i Sheba yumvise ingene Salomo ari umuntu ahambaye, n’ukuntu yahaye icubahiro izina ry’ Uhoraho , aja kumugerageresha ibibazo bigoye cane.
Ashika i Yerusalemu ari kumwe n’abamuherekeje benshi, ingamiya zikoreye ibimota neza, inzahabu nyinshi cane n’amabuye y’agaciro, maze aja aho Salomo ari aganira na we ivyo yiyumvira vyose.
Salomo yishura ibibazo vyose yamubajije, ntihagira na kimwe kinanira umwami kumusigurira.
Umwamikazi w’i Sheba abonye ubwenge bwose bwa Salomo n’ingoro yubatse,
ivyokurya vyo ku meza yiwe, ivyicaro vy’abatware biwe, abakozi biwe bagabura ku meza n’imyambaro yabo, abamuhereza ivyo kunywa, n’ibimazi bituriwe yatanga mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , aratangara cane.
Abarira umwami ati: “Ivyo numviye mu gihugu canje ku vyerekeye ivyo wakoze hamwe n’ubwenge bwawe, nsanze vyari ivy’ukuri.
Ariko sinari navyizeye gushika nishikiye hano nkavyibonera n’amaso yanje ubwanje. Mu vy’ukuri, nta n’igice bambwiye c’ingene ubwenge bwawe bungana; birarengeye kure cane ivyo bambwiye.
Erega abantu bawe barahiriwe! Eka n’abagendanyi bawe na bo nyene barahiriwe, bo bama bahagaze imbere yawe imisi yose, bumviriza ivy’ubwenge bwawe!

Uhoraho Imana yawe iragahimbazwa, kuko wayihimbaye maze ikagushira ku ngoma y’Abisirayeli ngo uganze mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yawe. Ku bw’urukundo rudashira Uhoraho afitiye Isirayeli, yakugize umwami kugira ngo uganze mu butungane no mu kugororoka.”

Maze aca ashikanira umwami italanto ijana na mirongo ibiri z’inzahabu, ibimota neza vyinshi, n’amabuye y’igiciro. Nta n’umwe yongeye gushikanira umwami ibimota neza bingana n’ivyo umwamikazi w’i Sheba yashikaniye umwami Salomo.
I ruhande y’ivyo, amato ya Hiramu yazanye inzahabu zivuye muri Ofiru, yongera azana n’imbaho nyinshi z’igiti ca alumugi hamwe n’amabuye y’agaciro.

Umwami aca akoresha izo mbaho mu gushigikira Ingoro y’ Uhoraho hamwe n’ikirimba ciwe; yongera azikoramwo amakembe n’inanga vy’abacuraranzi. Nta mbaho za alumugi zingana gutyo zari bwaze kandi nta zirasubira kuboneka kugeza n’uwu musi.

Umwami Salomo aha umwamikazi w’i Sheba ivyo yipfuza n’ivyo yasavye vyose, amwihera n’izindi ngabire nk’uko umugenzo w’ubugwaneza bw’umwami Salomo wari uri. Maze arahaguruka asubira mu gihugu ciwe n’abari kumwe na we.
Ingabire Salomo yaronka ku mwaka ku mwaka zangana n’italanto amajana atandatu na mirongo itandatu na zitandatu z’inzahabu,
udashizemwo ubundi butunzi yaronka biciye mu makori abadandaza batanga hamwe n’ayava mu bami bose bo muri Arabiya n’abatware bo mu gihugu ciwe.
Umwami Salomo acurisha inkinzo nininini amajana abiri mu nzahabu; imwimwe yose itwara shekeli amajana atandatu z’inzahabu.
Acurisha n’izindi nkinzo ntonto amajana atatu mu nzahabu, imwe yose ikajako ingero mina zitatu z’inzahabu. Umwami aca azibika mu ngoro yise Ishamba ry’i Libani.
Hanyuma umwami akoresha intebe y’ubwami nini isharijwe n’amahembe y’inzovu ayomekako inzahabu ihinguwe neza.

Iyo ntebe yari ifise ingazi zitandatu, kandi ku mutwe w’aho begamira hari hameze nk’umuzingi. Ku mpande zose z’iyo ntebe hari ivyo gushirako amaboko, kandi hari n’ibishushanyo vy’intare bibiri bihagaze i ruhande y’amaboko.
Hari n’ibindi bishushanyo cumi na bibiri vy’intare, kimwekimwe ku mpera y’ingazi yose muri zimwe zitandatu. Nta ntebe nk’iyo yari bwigere iboneka mu bwami na bumwe.

Ibikombe vyose vy’umwami Salomo vyari bikozwe mu nzahabu, n’ibikoresho vyose vyo mu ngoro yise Ikibira c’i Libani vyari bikozwe mu nzahabu ihinguwe neza. Nta na kimwe cari gikozwe mw’ifeza, kuko ifeza yafatwa nk’aho ifise agaciro gato mu gihe ca Salomo.

Umwami yari afise amato yo kudandaza yaja i Tarushishi yajana n’aya Hiramu. Uko imyaka itatu iheze ayo mato yaba agarutse avuye i Tarushishi, azanye inzahabu, ifeza, amahembe y’inzovu, inkende n’amadendo.
Maze umwami Salomo aba agahambaye mu butunzi no mu bwenge kurusha abandi bami bose bo kw’isi.
Abantu bose bo kw’isi bama basaba umubonano kwa Salomo ngo bumvirize ubwenge Imana yamuhaye.
Ku mwaka ku mwaka, abaja kumuraba umwe wese yagenda amushikaniye ifeza n’inzahabu, amakanzu, ibigwanisho, ibimota neza, amafarasi n’inyumbu.

Maze Salomo yegeranya imikogote y’intambara n’amafarasi menshi. Yari afise imikogote igihumbi n’amajana ane, n’amafarasi ibihumbi cumi na bibiri. Bimwe abibika mu bisagara vy’imikogote, ibindi abigumiza hafi yiwe i Yerusalemu.
Umwami agwiza ifeza i Yerusalemu zisigara zimeze nk’amabuye, imbaho z’agaciro z’amasederi na zo ziragwira zimera nk’ibiti vy’imisukomora vyo mu biyaya vy’i Buyuda.
Amafarasi ya Salomo yari yayakuye muri Egiputa n’i Kilikiya; abadandaza b’umwami bari bayaguriye muri Kilikiya ku giciro gisanzwe.

Umukogote umwe bawugura muri Egiputa shekeli amajana atandatu z’ifeza, ifarasi imwe na yo bakayigura shekeli ijana na mirongo itanu. Kandi abo badandaza ni bo banabigurisha no ku bami bose b’Abaheti n’ab’Abarameya.
Umwami Salomo akunda abagore benshi b’abanyamahangakazi. I ruhande y’umukobwa wa Farawo, yari afise abagore b’Abanyamowabukazi, Abamonikazi, Abanyedomukazi, Abanyesidonikazi n’Abahetikazi.
Abo bose bava mu mahanga Uhoraho yari yaravuzeko ati: “Ntimuze murongore abagore bo muri bo, kuko nimwabikora bazobakwegera mu gusenga imana zabo.” Ariko Salomo we ahitamwo kubakunda n’aho vyari uko.
Yari afise abagore amajana indwi bava mu miryango y’abami, n’abandi amajana atatu b’incoreke, maze abo bagore baramuzimiza, bamutesha inzira y’Imana.
Uko Salomo yasaza ni ko abagore biwe bakwegakwegera umutima wiwe ku zindi mana, ntiyaba aciyeguriye wese Uhoraho Imana yiwe, nk’uko se yari yiyeguriye wese Uhoraho .
Nuko akurikira Ashitaroti imanakazi y’Abanyesidoni, na Moleki ikizira c’ubuyobe c’Abamoni.
Uko ni ko Salomo yakoze ibizira mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , ntiyakurikira Uhoraho n’umutima wiwe wose nk’uko se Dawidi yabikoze.
Mw’itaba ry’umusozi uri amaja mu buseruko bwa Yerusalemu, Salomo ahubaka ikibanza co gusengeramwo Kemoshi, ikizira c’ubuyobe c’imana y’Abanyamowabu, n’ica Moleki ikizira c’ubuyobe c’imana y’Abamoni.
Yubakira n’abandi bagore bose b’abanyamahangakazi ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo nk’ivyo, na bo bakabishikaniramwo imana zabo imibavu yo guturira, bakahatangira n’ibimazi.
Uburake bw’ Uhoraho buziriringira Salomo, kuko umutima wiwe wari wavuye ku Mana ya Isirayeli, kandi yari yamwiyeretse incuro zibiri zose.
Uhoraho yari yarihanikirije Salomo ngo ntazosenge izindi mana, ariko Salomo ntiyamwumvira.
Uhoraho abarira Salomo ati: “Ko wakoze ivyo, ntuzigame isezerano n’amabwirizwa naguhaye, ubwami bwawe nzobutabura ndabuhe umwe mu bakozi bawe.
Ariko ku bwa so Dawidi, sinzobikora ukiriho. Nzobutaburira mu maboko y’umuhungu wawe.
Kandi naho bizoba bimeze gutyo, sinzomunyaga ubwami bwose, nzomuha intara imwe ku bwa Dawidi umusavyi wanje, no ku bwa Yerusalemu nitoranirije.”
Uhoraho ahagurutsa Hadadi Umunyedomu wo mu muryango w’abami ba Edomu, agwanya Salomo.
Dawidi akigwanya Abanyedomu, Yowabu umukuru w’abasoda yari yaduze guhamba Abisirayeli bari baguye ku rugamba, asiga ahoneje abagabo bose b’Abanyedomu.
Yowabu n’ingabo z’Abisirayeli baca bamarayo amezi atandatu, kugeza bahoneje abagabo bose muri Edomu.
Hadadi yari akiri umwana w’umuhungu igihe yahungira muri Egiputa ari kumwe n’abatware b’Abanyedomu bakoreye se.
Bahunze bava i Midiyani, baja i Parani. Bahitana abantu i Parani baja muri Egiputa kwa Farawo umwami wa Egiputa, Farawo aha Hadadi inzu n’itongo, amuha n’ivyokurya.
Farawo yarakunda Hadadi cane bituma amuha uwavukana n’umugore wiwe, umwamikazi Tahipenesi, aba muka Hadadi.
Uwo mugore avyaye umwana kuri Hadadi yitwa Genubati, umwamikazi Tahipenesi aca amurerera ku kirimba hamwe n’abana ba Farawo.
Hadadi akiri muri Egiputa, yumva ko Dawidi yahambije ba sekuruza, ko na Yowabu umukuru w’abasoda na we nyene yapfuye; ni ko kubwira Farawo ati: “Ndeka nsubire mu gihugu canje.”
Farawo aramubaza ati: “Mbega hari ico wabuze ngaha aho ugomba gusubira mu gihugu cawe?” Hadadi amwishura ati: “Nta co nabuze, ariko ndeka ngende!”
Uhoraho yongera avyurira Salomo uwundi mwansi ari we Rezoni mwene Eliyada. Rezoni yari yarahunze shebuja, Hadadezeri umwami w’i Zoba,
hanyuma aba umukuru w’akagwi k’abagwanyi. Dawidi amaze gufata Hadadezeri, Razoni n’abantu biwe baciye bahungira i Damasiko, aca yigira umwami waho.
Rezoni aba umwansi wa Isirayeli imyaka yose Salomo yabayeho, abakorera ikibi nk’ico Hadadi yabakorera. Rezoni aba umwami w’i Siriya, kandi agirira Isirayeli urwanko rwinshi.
Yerobowamu mwene Nebati na we nyene agarariza umwami. Yari umutware umwe mu batware ba Salomo. Yava mu gisagara ca Zereda muri Efurayimu, nyina yari umupfakazi yitwa Zeruwa.
Ukugarariza kwiwe kwagenze gutya: igihe Salomo yariko arubaka ikibuga yongera asanura ahasambutse h’uruzitiro rw’igisagara ca se Dawidi.
Yerobowamu yari umusore w’umunyenkomezi nyinshi. Salomo abonye ingene ari umunyabikorwa, aca amuha gukoresha abagurano bo mu muryango wa Yosefu.
Umusi umwe Yerobowamu yari avuye i Yerusalemu, Ahiya umuvugishwa w’i Shilo aza kumutegera yambaye umutamana mushasha. Bashitse mu gahinga ari babiri bonyene,
Ahiya afata wa mutamana mushasha yari yambaye awutaburamwo ibice cumi na bibiri.
Aca abarira Yerobowamu ati: “Akira ibice cumi, kuko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze ati: ‘Ehe raba ngiye gutabura ubwami bwa Salomo ndaguhemwo imiryango cumi.
Ariko ku bw’umusavyi wanje Dawidi n’igisagara ca Yerusalemu nitoranirije mu miryango yose ya Isirayeli, azosigarana umuryango umwe.

Ivyo nzobikora kuko bantaye, bagasenga Ashitaroti imanakazi y’Abanyesidoni, Kemoshi imana y’Abanyamowabu, Moleki imana y’Abamoni, ntibagendera mu nzira zanje canke ngo bakore ibiroranye mu nyonga zanje, ntibazigama amategeko n’amabwirizwa yanje nk’uko se Dawidi yabikora.
Ariko sinzomutwara ubwami bwose. Ku bw’umusavyi wanje Dawidi, uwo nitoranirije, akagendera mu mabwirizwa n’amategeko yanje, nzoreka Salomo aganze gushika apfe.
Umuhungu wiwe ni we nzokwaka ubwami, ndabuguhemwo imiyango cumi.
Umuhungu wiwe nzomuha umuryango umwe, kugira ngo ku ngoma haze hame hariho uwuganza akomoka kuri Dawidi, amere kurya kw’itara ryakira i Yerusalemu, igisagara natoranije nkacitirira izina ryanje.
Ariko wewe, nzokwimika ku ngoma ya Isirayeli, utware aho umutima wawe wipfuza hose, ube umwami wa Isirayeli.

Niwakora ivyo nzogutegeka vyose, ukagendera mu mabwirizwa yanje, ukagendera mu nzira zanje, ugakora ibibereye mu nyonga zanje mu gukurikiza amabwirizwa n’amategeko yanje, nk’uko umusavyi wanje Dawidi yabigenza, nzobana nawe. Nzokwubakira inzu yama ku ngoma nk’iyo nubakiye Dawidi, nongere ndaguhe Isirayeli.
Uko ni ko nzohana uruvyaro rwa Dawidi kubera icaha ca Salomo, ariko ntibazokwama mu gihano ibihe vyose.’ ”
Salomo agerageza kwica Yerobowamu, ariko Yerobowamu aca ahungira kwa Shishaki umwami wa Egiputa, agumayo gushika Salomo apfuye.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Salomo, ivyo yaranguye vyose hamwe n’ubwenge bwiwe, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’Ibikorwa vya Salomo?
Igihe Salomo yamaze ku ngoma i Yerusalemu aganza Abisirayeli bose ni imyaka mirongo ine.
Nuko Salomo arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa mu gisagara ca se Dawidi. Maze umuhungu wiwe Rehobowamu amusubirira ku ngoma.
Rehobowamu aja i Shekemu aho Abisirayeli bose bari bakoraniye kugira ngo bamwimike abe umwami.
Yerobowamu mwene Nebati avyumvise ari muri Egiputa, aho yari yarahungiye umwami Salomo, aca aragaruka.
Nuko batumako Yerobowamu, maze we n’ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli baja aho Rehobowamu ari bamubwira bati:
“So yadutwaje umukazo, none turagusavye utugabanirize umuruho w’ibikorwa bigoye yadutegetse gukora, natwe tuzoba abasavyi bawe.”
Rehobowamu abishura ati: “Nimutahe mbanze ndavyiyumvire, muze mugaruke inyuma y’imisi itatu.” Nuko abo bantu baca baragenda.
Umwami Rehobowamu aca agisha inama abatware bakoranye na se Salomo akiriho. Arababaza ati: “Mungiriye inama ki? Aba bantu ndabishure iki?”
Na bo baramwishura bati: “Uyu musi niwumvira aba bantu ukabagirira neza, ukabaha inyishu nziza, bazokwama bagukorera ibihe vyose.”
Ariko Rehobowamu yanka impanuro abahumure bamuhaye, aca asiguza abasore bakuranye na we bari mu bamukorera.
Arababaza ati: “Mumpanuye iki? Nokwishura iki aba bantu bambwiye bati: ‘Turemurure umutwaro so yaturemetse’?”

Ba basore bakuranye na we bamwishura bati: “Abo bantu bakubwiye bati, ‘So yaturemetse imitwaro ituvuna, ariko weho uturemurure iyo mitwaro’; babwire uti, ‘Urutoke rwanje rw’uruhererezi rusumvya ubunini umugongo wa data.
Data yabaremereje ibikorwa vyinshi, ni ko: ariko jeho nzobibaremereza gusumba. Data yabakubitisha ikimoko, jeho nzobarisha sikoropiyo!’ ”
Haheze imisi itatu, Yerobowamu na ba bantu bagaruka kuraba umwami Rehobowamu, nk’uko yari yabibabwiye, ati: “Muze mugaruke mu misi itatu.”
Maze umwami abishura abakankamira, kuko yari yanse impanuro yahawe n’abahumure,
akumvira impanuro z’imisore yakuranye na we. Abishura ati: “Data yabaremereje ibikorwa bigoye, jeho nzobibaremereza gusumba. Data yabakubitisha ikimoko, jeho nzobarisha sikoropiyo.”
Nuko umwami ntiyumvira abo bantu, kuko Uhoraho ari we yatumye vyose bigenda gutyo, kugira ngo ashitse ico yari yarasezeraniye Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, abicishije kuri Ahiya w’i Shilo.

Maze Abisirayeli bose babonye ko umwami yanse kubumviriza, bishura umwami bati: “Hari umugabane dufise mu muryango wa Dawidi? Nta co twiteze kuronka kuri mwene Isayi. Yemwe Bisirayeli, mwese nimusubire mu ngo zanyu. Nawe Dawidi, urimenya urabe inzu yawe!” Nuko Abisirayeli basubira iwabo.
Ariko Abisirayeli bagumye baba mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, bobo Rehobowamu yagumye abaganza.

Umwami Rehobowamu arungika Adoramu yari ajejwe ibikorwa vy’agahato, kugira ngo agarukane umutekano, ariko Abisirayeli bose bamutera amabuye arapfa. Maze umwami Rehobowamu, yurira umukogote wiwe arahunga aja i Yerusalemu.
Uko ni ko imiryango ya Isirayeli yo mu buraruko yanse kuganzwa n’inzu ya Dawidi gushika n’uwu musi.
Abisirayeli bumvise ko Yerobowamu yagarutse avuye muri Egiputa, baca batumako ikoraniro, bamugira umwami wa Isirayeli. Umuryango wa Yuda ni wo wonyene wasigaye uyoboka abo mu muryango wa Dawidi.

Rehobowamu ashitse i Yerusalemu, akoranya Abayuda bose n’umuryango w’Ababenyamini, abatoranyamwo imisore ishobora kugwana ibihumbi ijana na mirongo umunani kugira ngo baje gutera Abisirayeli, bagarurire ubwami Rehobowamu mwene Salomo.
Ariko ijambo ry’Imana riza kuri Shemaya umuntu w’Imana, riti:
“Barira Rehobowamu mwene Salomo umwami w’i Buyuda, n’abo mu muryango wa Yuda n’uwa Benyamini, hamwe n’abasigaye bose,

uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ntimuduge kugwanya abavukanyi banyu ari bo Bisirayeli. Umwe wese muri mwebwe nasubire iwe, kuko ivyabaye vyose ari jewe nabigize.’ ” Nuko bumvira ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , basubira iwabo nk’uko Uhoraho yari abibategetse.
Maze Yerobowamu yubaka igisagara c’i Shekemu co mu ntara y’imitumba ya Efurayimu, aba ari ho aba. Hanyuma avayo, yubaka igisagara c’i Peniyeli.
Yerobowamu yibwira mu mutima ati: “Nintaba maso, ubwami burasubira mu ruvyaro rwa Dawidi.

Aba bantu nibakomeza kwama baja i Yerusalemu gushikanira ibimazi Uhoraho mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , bazohava basubira kugirana isezerano na Rehobowamu umwami w’i Buyuda, baheze banyice, hanyuma bisubirire ku mwami Rehobowamu.”
Uwo mwami amaze guhanuza, aca acurisha amashuri abiri mu nzahabu. Aca abwira abantu ati: “Yemwe Bisirayeli, birabaruhishije kwama muduga i Yerusalemu. Ng’izi imana zanyu zabakuye muri Egiputa.”
Imwe ayishinga i Beteli mu bumanuko, iyindi ayishinga mu buraruko, mu ntara ya Dani.
Maze ico kintu gihindukira abantu icaha gikomeye, ku buryo hariho n’abagenda gusenga ic’i Beteli, bagaca bongera bagafata urugendo rurerure baja gusenga ico kindi c’i Dani.
Yerobowamu yubaka ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi, agena n’abaherezi mu miryango yose, naho bataba bava mu Balewi.

Aca ashinga ko ku musi ugira cumi na gatanu w’ukwezi kw’umunani hazohora haba muri Isirayeli umusi mukuru, kugira ngo yigane umusi mukuru w’insago wahimbazwa i Buyuda. Ivyo yabigiriye i Beteli, ashikanira ibimazi iyo shuri yacurishije. I Beteli nyene ahagena n’abaherezi bo mu bibanza vyo gusengeramwo yubatse.

Ku musi ugira cumi na gatanu w’ukwezi kw’umunani, ukwezi yihitiyemwo wenyene, ashikanira ibimazi ku gicaniro yubatse i Beteli. Nuko ashinga uwo musi mukuru kubw’Abisirayeli bose, hanyuma yurira ku gicaniro gutanga ibimazi.
Umuntu w’Imana ava i Buyuda aja i Beteli atumwe n’Imana, ashika igihe Yerobowamu yari ahagaze imbere y’igicaniro i Beteli agira atange ibimazi.

Aca arasemerera uko abwiwe n’Imana, abwira ico gicaniro ati: “Wa gicaniro we, ewe wa gicaniro! Nguku uko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Mu muryango wa Dawidi hazovuka umuhungu yitwa Yosiya. Kuri wewe ni ho azokererera abaherezi b’ibigirwamana vyo mu mataba y’imisozi baza kugutangirako ibimazi, kandi kuri wewe ni ho bazoturirira amagufa y’abantu.’ ”
Uwo musi nyene, uwo muntu w’Imana aca atanga ikimenyetso co kwemeza ivyo avuze, ati: “ Uhoraho atanze iki kimenyetso: Iki gicaniro kigira gisadukemwo kubiri, iminyota yose yari kuri co iseseke hasi.”

Umwami Yerobowamu yumvise ivyo uwo muntu w’Imana asemereye abwira ico gicaniro c’i Beteli, aramvura ukuboko amutunga urutoke, ahagaze i ruhande ya ca gicaniro, avuga ati: “Mufate!” Kwa kuboko amutumberejeko guca kuradadarara ntivyakunda ko asubira kukwigarukanako.
Ca gicaniro gica gisadukamwo kubiri, iminyota yose yari kuri co iseseka hasi nk’uko wa muntu w’Imana yari yabivugishijwe n’ijambo rivuye k’ Uhoraho .

Umwami aca abarira wa muntu w’Imana ati: “Ndagusavye nyingingira Uhoraho Imana yawe, ukuboko kwanje gusubire kumere uko kwahora.” Wa muntu w’Imana yinginga Uhoraho , kwa kuboko kw’Umwami gusubira kumera neza.
Umwami aca abarira uwo muntu w’Imana ati: “Ingo tujane iwanje, ndakuzimane, kandi ndaguhe n’ingabire.”
Wa muntu w’Imana aramwishura ati: “N’aho wombwira ko umpa igice c’ivyo utunze vyose, sinojana nawe, kandi sinogira ico ndira canke nywera ngaha.
Kuko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryantegetse riti: ‘Ntihaze hagire ico urya canke unywa, kandi ntuzogarukane inzira wajanye.’ ”
Nuko aca afata iyindi nzira, ntiyasubira inyuma aciye mu nzira yazananye aje i Beteli.
Igihe ivyo vyaba, hariho umuvugishwa n’Imana wa kera yaba i Beteli, abahungu biwe batashe bamubwira ivyo uwo muntu w’Imana yakoreye i Beteli uwo musi, bongera bamubwira n’ivyo yabariye umwami.
Se arababaza ati: “Mu gusubira inyuma yajanye inzira iyihe?” Na bo barayimwereka.
Aca abarira abo bahungu biwe ati: “Nimuntegurire indogoba.” Barayimutegurira, na we ayicarako,
akurikira uwo muntu w’Imana, amusanga yicaye musi y’igiti c’umwelayo, aramubaza ati: “Ni wewe muntu w’Imana wavuye i Buyuda?” Na we arishura ati: “Ni jewe.”
Wa muvugishwa aramubwira ati: “Ingo dutahane i muhira ndakuzimane.”
Wa muntu w’Imana aramwishura ati: “Sinshobora gusubira inyuma ngo njane nawe, kandi sinshobora kugira ico ndya canke nywa aha hantu,
kuko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryambariye riti: ‘Ntihazogire ico urya canke unywa, kandi ntuzoce mu nzira wajanye mu gusubira inyuma.’ ”

Wa muvugishwa wa kera aramubarira ati: “Nanje ndi umuvugishwa n’Imana nkawe. Kandi umumarayika yampaye ijambo rivuye k’ Uhoraho rivuga riti: ‘Genda umugarukane i muhira iwawe, afungure yongere anywe amazi.’ ” Ariko yariko aramubesha.
Wa muntu w’Imana aca asubirana inyuma na we, arira mu nzu y’uwo muvugishwa, yongera anywaho n’amazi.
Bacicaye ku meza, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riza kuri wa muvugishwa wa kera yagarukanye wa muntu w’Imana.
Arasemerera abarira wa muntu w’Imana yavuye i Buyuda ati: “ Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Wahinduye ubusa ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , ntiwakurikije itegeko Uhoraho Imana yawe yaguhaye.
Wasubiye inyuma, urira kandi unywera mu kibanza Uhoraho yakubujije kuriramwo no kunyweramwo. None rero umuvyimba wawe ntuzohambwa mu mva ya ba sogokuruza bawe.’ ”
Wa muntu w’Imana ahejeje kurya no kunywa, wa muvugishwa aca amutegurira indogoba,
wa muntu w’Imana aca asubira gufata urugendo. Ariko akiri mu nzira, ahura n’intare, iramwica. Umuvyimba wiwe uca uguma urambitse ku nzira, ya ndogoba na ya ntare biguma bihagaze i ruhande yawo.
Abantu barengana babonye uwo muvyimba uryamye hasi, bakabona na ya ntare ihagaze i ruhande yawo, baca baja kubivuga muri ca gisagara wa muvugishwa wa kera yabamwo.

Wa muvugishwa yari yamugarukanye avyumvise, aravuga ati: “Uwo ni wa muntu w’Imana yahindura ubusa ijambo ry’ Uhoraho . Uhoraho yamurekuriyeko intambwe iramwica nk’uko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryari ryamuburiye.”
Uwo muvugishwa aca abwira abahungu biwe ati: “Ntegurire indogoba.” Na bo barayimutegurira.
Nuko aragenda asanga wa muvyimba urambaraye hasi, na ya ndogoba n’intare bihagaze i ruhande yawo. Iyo ntare ntiyari yariye uwo muvyimba, nta n’ico yagize iyo ndogoba.
Wa muvugishwa aca afata wa muvyimba wa wa muntu w’Imana, awushira ku ndogoba, awuzana mu gisagara c’i Beteli, kugira ngo amugandarire, hanyuma amuhambe.
Nuko aryamika ico kiziga mu mva yiwe, amuborogera cane avuga ati: “Yo, muvukanyi!”
Ahejeje kumuhamba, abarira abahungu biwe ati: “Ninapfa, muzompambe mu mva urya muntu w’Imana yahambwemwo, amagufa yanje muzoyaryamike i ruhande y’ayiwe.
Kuko ijambo Uhoraho yamubwiye ngo avugire ku gicaniro i Beteli no mu bibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi mu bisagara vy’i Samariya nta nkeka rizoshika.”

Ariko n’inyuma y’ivyo, Yerobowamu ntiyahevye inzira ziwe mbi, ahubwo yasubijeho abaherezi ku mitumba, bava mu bantu abo ari bo bose. Hagize uwumva ashaka kuba umuherezi wese yaca amurobanura, akaba umuherezi muri ivyo bibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi.
Ico cabereye umuryango wa Yerobowamu icaha kinini, catumye ingoma yiwe isenyuka, irazimangana kw’isi.
Ico gihe Abiya umuhungu wa Yerobowamu aragwara cane.
Yerobowamu abarira umugore wiwe ati: “Niwiyoberanye kugira ngo ntihagire uwumenya ko uri umwamikazi, uheze uje i Shilo ku muvugishwa Ahiya abayo, umwe yambwira ko nzoba umwami.
Ujane amarobe cumi y’imitsima n’udukate, utware n’agakarabo k’umutsama w’ubuki, uje kumuraba, umubaze ibizoshikira uwu umuhungu.”
Nuko umugore wa Yerobowamu abigenza nk’uko yabimubwiye, aja kwa Ahiya i Shilo. Ico gihe Ahiya ntiyari akibona neza kuko yari ashaje cane.
Ariko Uhoraho yari yabariye Ahiya ati: “Umugore wa Yerobowamu araja kuza kukubaza ivy’umuhungu wiwe, kuko agwaye cane. Uze kumubwira uko nza kukubwira. Aja kuza yiyoberanije, yigize uwundi mugore.”
Ahiya yumvise ibirenge vyiwe acinjira mu muryango, aca avuga ati: “Shika, yewe mugore wa Yerobowamu! Ni kubera iki wiyoberanije, ukigira uwundi mugore?” Yongera amubwira ati: “Ndagufitiye inkuru mbi.
Genda ubarire Yerobowamu uti: ‘ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze ati: Nagukuye mu bandi bantu basanzwe ndagushira hejuru, ndaguha kuganza ubwoko bwanje bwa Isirayeli.
Nasambuye ubwami ndabwaka uruvyaro rwa Dawidi ndabuha wewe, ariko ntiwambera umusavyi mwiza nka Dawidi, yubahirije amabwirizwa yanje, ankurikira n’umutima wiwe wose, akora ibibereye mu nyonga zanje.
Wakoze ibibi birushirije ivy’abandi babayeho imbere yawe. Wicuriye ibigirwamana mu vyuma, untera uburake, unshiburira inyuma yawe.

None rero nzoteza ivyago umuryango wa Yerobowamu, nice abahungu bawe ndabaherengeteze muri Isirayeli, baba abagurano canke abidegemvya. Nzotongora umuryango wa Yerobowamu nk’uwuturira umwanda akawumara.
Abo mu muryango wa Yerobowamu bazogwa mu gisagara bazoribwa n’imbwa; abazogwa mu gahinga bazoribwa n’ibisiga vyo mu kirere. Uko ni ko Uhoraho avuze.’ ”
Yongera abwira muka Yerobowamu ati: “Nayo wewe, subira inyuma, niwamara guhonyoza ikirenge mu gisagara cawe, umuhungu wawe aca acikana.
Abisirayeli bose bazomugandarira hanyuma bamuhambe. Ni we mwana wa Yerobowamu wenyene azohambwa, kuko mu ruvyaro rwa Yerobowamu uwo ari we wenyene Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli yagize iciza amubonako.
Uhoraho azokwihagurukiriza umwami muri Isirayeli azohonya umuryango wa Yerobowamu. Ivyo bigiye kuba vuba, kandi birashitse!

Ikindi, Uhoraho agiye gukubita Isirayeli, imere nk’irenga rikubebwa n’amazi. Azorandura Abisirayeli abakure mu gihugu ciza yahaye ba sekuruza, abashwiragirize hakurya y’uruzi Efurate, kuko bateye uburake Uhoraho mu gushinga inkingi za Ashera.
Kandi azota Isirayeli kubera ivyaha Yerobowamu yakoze, n’ivyo yakoresheje Abisirayeli.”
Muka Yerobowamu aca arahaguruka aragenda, aja i Tiriza. Acinjira mu muryango w’ingoro, wa mwana aca aracikana.
Nuko baramuhamba, Abisirayeli bose baramugandarira, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabivugishije umusavyi wiwe, umuvugishwa Ahiya.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yerobowamu, ivy’intambara yagwanye, n’ukuntu yatwaye, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami ba Isirayeli.
Yerobowamu yatwaye Isirayeli imyaka mirongo ibiri n’ibiri, hanyuma ahamvya ba sekuruza. Umuhungu wiwe Nadabu ni we yamusubiriye ku ngoma.

Rehobowamu mwene Salomo yari umwami w’i Buyuda. Yari afise imyaka mirongo ine n’umwe igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, hanyuma atwara imyaka cumi n’indwi, aba i Yerusalemu, igisagara Uhoraho yari yaratoranije mu miryango yose y’Abisirayeli ngo ahashire izina ryiwe. Nyina yitwa Nayama; yari Umwamonikazi.
Mu gihe Rehobowamu yari ku ngoma, Abayuda bakora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, bamutera ishavu gusumba uko ba sekuruza babikoze,
kuko biyubakiye ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi no musi y’ibiti bitotahaye, bakahashinga inkingi z’amabuye n’inkingi za Ashera.
Muri iyo ntara hariho n’abagabo n’abagore b’abamaraya mu bibanza vyo gusengeramwo. Abantu badukana ingeso z’abanyamahanga Uhoraho yirukanye muri ico gihugu imbere y’Abisirayeli.
Mu mwaka ugira gatanu Rehobowamu ari ku ngoma, Shishaki umwami wa Egiputa, atera Yerusalemu.
Asahura ubutunzi bwose bwari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho n’ubwari mu ngoro y’umwami. Atwara ibintu vyose, harimwo na za nkinzo z’inzahabu Salomo yari yaracurishije.
Nuko umwami Rehobowamu aca acurisha izindi nkinzo mu butare bw’umwakaka asubiriza zimwe za mbere, aca azizeza intwazangabo z’abacungera ku kirimba c’ingoro y’umwami.
Igihe cose umwami yagomba kwinjira mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , abacungera ku kirimba baca bajana na we bitwaje za nkinzo, mu nyuma bagaheza bakazisubiza mu cumba cazo.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Rehobowamu hamwe n’ivyo yakoze vyose, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’Ivyabaye ku bami b’i Buyuda?
Hama hari intambara z’urutavanako hagati ya Rehobowamu na Yerobowamu.
Rehobowamu arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa hamwe na bo mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Nyina wiwe yitwa Nayama, yari Umwamonikazi. Umuhungu wiwe Abiya amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira cumi n’umunani Yerobowamu mwene Nebati ari ku ngoma, ni ho Abiya yaba umwami w’i Buyuda,
maze aganza imyaka itatu aba i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Mayaka, umukobwa wa Abishalomu.
Yakoze ivyaha nk’ivyo se yakoze imbere yiwe, kandi umutima wiwe ntiwari ugororokeye Uhoraho Imana yiwe na mba, nk’uko sekuruza Dawidi yari ameze.

Ariko ku bwa Dawidi, Uhoraho Imana yiwe areka uruvyaro rwiwe ruguma ku ngoma, kugira ngo itara ryiwe ntirizime kandi kugira ngo Yerusalemu hazigamwe. Ni ko kumuhagurukiriza umwuzukuruza yitwa Abiya, yicara ku ngoma i Yerusalemu.
Dawidi yari yakoze ibibereye mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , ntiyatirimuka ku mabwirizwa yiwe ubuzima bwiwe bwose, kiretse ivyo yakoreye Uriya Umuheti.
Kandi ku ngoma ya Abiya, hagumye intambara hagati yiwe na Yerobowamu.
Ibindi bijanye n’ivyabaye ku ngoma ya Abiya hamwe n’ivyo yakoze vyose vyanditse mu gitabu c’Ivyabaye ku bami b’i Buyuda. Hagumye intambara hagati ya Abiya na Yerobowamu.
