Hanyuma Abiya arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Umuhungu wiwe Asa amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri Yerobowamu ari ku ngoma ya Isirayeli, Asa ni ho yaba umwami w’i Buyuda,
amara imyaka mirongo ine n’umwe aba i Yerusalemu. Inakuru yari Mayaka umukobwa wa Abishalomu.
Asa akora ibibereye mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho nk’uko sekuruza Dawidi yakoze.
Akura mu gihugu ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vy’abagabo n’abagore b’abamaraya, akuraho n’ibigirwamana ba sekuruza bashizeho.
Mbere yirukana inakuru Mayaka amwaka iteka ryo kuba nyina w’umwami, kuko yari yaracurishije igishushanyo c’ubuyobe ca Ashera. Asa atemagura ico kigirwamana, agituririra ku mwonga Kidironi.
Naho Asa atashoboye gukuraho ibibanza basengeramwo vyo ku mataba y’imisozi, yari yareguriye Uhoraho umutima wiwe wose imisi yose y’ukubaho kwiwe.
Yinjiza mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho ifeza n’inzahabu n’ibikoresho we na se bari bareguriye Uhoraho .
Hama hari intambara hagati ya Asa na Bayasha umwami wa Isirayeli igihe cose bamaze bari ku ngoma.
Bayasha umwami wa Isirayeli aduga gutera i Buyuda, yubaka uruzitiro rukikuje i Rama kugira ngo abuze umuntu wese yogomba kuja canke kuva kwa Asa umwami w’i Buyuda.

Maze Asa afata ifeza n’inzahabu zose zari zasigaye mu bubiko bwo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho no mu ngoro yiwe, azirungikana abatware, abatuma kwa Beni-Hadadi umwami w’i Siriya, yatwarira i Damasiko. Beni-Hadadi yari mwene Taburimoni, Taburimoni mwene Heziyoni. Nuko abarungikana n’ubutumwa buvuga ngo:

“Tugiriranire isezerano hagati yanje nawe, nk’uko vyari biri hagati ya data na so. Raba, ndakurungikiye ifeza n’inzahabu. None rero nureke isezerano rya mwe na Bayasha umwami wa Isirayeli kugira ngo asubire inyuma areke kuntera.”
Beni-Hadadi yemeranya n’umwami Asa, arungika intwazangabo ziwe gutera ibisagara vya Isirayeli, bafata Iyoni, Dani, Abeli-Beti-Mayaka, bafata Kinereti hose hamwe n’intara ya Nafutali.
Bayasha avyumvise, aca areka kwubaka i Rama, asubira i Tiriza.

Maze umwami Asa ategeka abantu b’i Buyuda bose ata n’umwe avuyemwo, bakurayo amabuye n’imbaho zose Bayasha yariko arakoresha. Asa aca abikoresha mu kuzitira ibisagara vya Geba mu ntara ya Benyamini hamwe n’igisagara ca Misipa.

Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Asa, ivy’ubutwari bwiwe, ivyo yakoze, n’ivy’ibisagara yubatse, mbega ntivyanditse mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda? Asa ageze mu zabukuru, agwara ibirenge.
Hanyuma Asa arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa hamwe na bo mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Umuhungu wiwe Yehoshafati amusubirira ku ngoma.
Nadabu mwene Yerobowamu yabaye umwami wa Isirayeli mu mwaka ugira kabiri Asa ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, aganza Isirayeli imyaka ibiri.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, agendera mu ngeso za se no mu vyaha yakora, atuma n’Abisirayeli babikora.

Bayasha mwene Ahiya wo mu muryango wa Isakari, ategura umugambi wo kwica umwami. Igihe Nadabu n’ingabo za Isirayeli bari bateye igisagara ca Gibetoni caganzwa n’Abafilisitiya, Bayasha yica umwami Nadabu.
Bayasha yishe Nadabu mu mwaka ugira gatatu Asa ari ku ngoma y’i Buyuda. Bayasha aca aba umwami, asubirira Nadabu.

Agishika ku ngoma, yica umuryango wose wa Yerobowamu. Mu muryango wa Yerobowamu, nta n’umwe yasigaye, yarabatikije bose, nk’uko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryari ryabivuze aciye ku musavyi wiwe Ahiya w’i Shilo.
Ivyo vyabaye kuko Yerobowamu yari yakoze ivyaha vyinshi, atuma n’Abisirayeli babikora, ari co catumye uburake bw’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli bumuziriringira.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Nadabu hamwe n’ivyo yakoze, vyanditse mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku bami ba Isirayeli.
Hama hari intambara hagati ya Asa na Bayasha umwami wa Isirayeli igihe cose bamaze bari ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira gatatu Asa ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, Bayasha mwene Ahiya ni ho yaba umwami w’Abisirayeli bose. Yaba i Tiriza, aganza Isirayeli imyaka mirongo ibiri n’ine.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, agendera mu ngeso za se no mu vyaha yakora, atuma n’Abisirayeli na bo babikora.
Maze Ijambo rivuye k’ Uhoraho rishikirizwa Bayasha riciye ku wavugishwa n’Imana Yehu mwene Hanani,

rivuga riti: “Naguhagurukije ndagukuye mu mukungungu, ndakugira umutware w’ubwoko bwanje bwa Isirayeli, ariko ugendera mu ngeso za Yerobowamu, utuma ubwoko bwanje bucumura, bituma ndabarakarira kubera ivyaha vyabo.
None ngiye kukurandurana n’umuryango wawe, ndawugire nk’uko nagize uwa Yerobowamu mwene Nebati.
Imbwa ni zo zizorya abawe bazogwa mu gisagara, nayo abazogwa mu gahinga bazoribwa n’ibisiga vyo mu kirere.”
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Bayasha, ivyo yakoze n’ivyo yashitseko, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku bami ba Isirayeli.
Hanyuma Bayasha ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa i Tiriza. Umuhungu wiwe Ela aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.

Ariko kandi, Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryari ryarashikirijwe Bayasha n’umuryango wiwe riciye kuri wa muvugishwa Yehu mwene Hanani, kubera ibintu bibiri: ivyaha vyose yakoreye mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , bituma Uhoraho amurakira, amugira nk’umuryango wa Yerobowamu, hamwe rero no kuba ari we yatikije umuryango wa Yerobowamu.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri na gatandatu Asa umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, Ela mwene Bayasha ni ho yimikwa nk’umwami wa Isirayeli, amara imyaka ibiri aba i Tiriza.

Umwe mu bakuru b’abasoda yatwara ica kabiri c’imikogote y’umwami yitwa Zimuri, agira imigabo yo kwica umwami Ela. Umusi umwe, Ela yari i Tiriza, ariko anywera kwa Arusa umukuru w’ikirimba, kandi akaba yamaze kuborerwa.
Zimuri arinjira, amutsindaho, aramwica. Hari mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri n’indwi Asa umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma. Nuko Zimuri aca aramusubirira, aba umwami.
Agitangura gutwara, yicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami, yicisha umuryango wose wa Bayasha, ntiyasigaza icitwa umuhungu, haba mu ncuti canke mu bagenzi biwe.
Uko ni ko Zimuri yaranduye umuryango wa Bayasha, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabibwiye Bayasha aciye ku wavugishwa n’Imana Yehu.

Ivyo vyabaye kubera ivyaha Bayasha n’umuhungu wiwe Ela bakoze, batuma n’Abisirayeli babikora, batuma uburake bw’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli buziriringa kubera ibitagira ikimazi ari vyo bigirwamana vyabo.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Ela hamwe n’ivyo yakoze, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku bami ba Isirayeli.

Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri n’indwi Asa umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, Zimuri ni ho yima i Tiriza, amara imisi indwi ari ku ngoma. Ingabo za Isirayeli zari zagize igitero ku gisagara c’Abafilisitiya citwa Gibetoni.

Abasoda b’Abisirayeli bumvise ko Zimuri ari we yateguye kwica umwami hanyuma akamugandagura, baca bimika Omuri umukuru w’abasoda, aba ari we bagira umwami wa Isirayeli, uwo musi nyene, muri iyo kambi nyene.
Omuri n’abasoda b’Abisirayeli baca bava i Gibetoni batera i Tiriza barahigarurira.
Zimuri abonye ko igisagara gifashwe, aca yinjira mu munara w’ikirimba, yituririrako inzu, yicwa n’umuriro.
Ivyo vyamubayeko kuko na we nyene yakoze ivyo Uhoraho yabona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, mu kugendera mu ngeso za Yerobowamu no mu vyaha yakoze, akabikoresha n’Abisirayeli.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Zimuri n’ivy’ubugarariji yagize, vyanditse mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku bami ba Isirayeli.
Zimuri amaze gupfa, ubwoko bwa Isirayeli buca bwigaburamwo kabiri, bamwe bakurikira Tibuni mwene Ginati ngo ababere umwami, abandi bakurikira Omuri.
Ariko abayoboka Omuri bari bakomeye gusumba abayoboka Tibuni mwene Ginati. Nuko Tibuni aricwa, Omuri aca aba umwami.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu na rimwe Asa umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, ni ho Omuri yatangura kuganza Isirayeli, amara imyaka cumi n’ibiri yose hamwe, ariko itandatu muri yo yayimaze i Tiriza.
Hanyuma umwami Omuri agurira Shemeri umusozi witwa Samariya. Awugura italanto zibiri z’ifeza, awubakako igisagara, acita Samariya, rivuye muri Shemeri, izina ry’uwo yahaguriye.
Ariko Omuri akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, akora ivyaha biruta ivy’abatwaye imbere yiwe.

Agendera mu nzira za Yerobowamu mwene Nebati no mu vyaha yakora, atuma n’Abisirayeli babikora, maze batera uburake Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli, bayirakishije ibitagira ikimazi ari vyo bigirwamana vyabo.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Omuri, ivyo yakoze n’ivyo yashitseko, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku bami ba Isirayeli.
Nuko Omuri ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa i Samariya. Umuhungu wiwe Ahabu amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu n’umunani Asa ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, Ahabu mwene Omuri ni ho yaba umwami wa Isirayeli, amara imyaka mirongo ibiri n’ibiri i Samariya aganza Isirayeli.
Ahabu mwene Omuri yakoze ibibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho biruta ivy’abatwaye imbere yiwe.

Mbere nk’aho womenga kugendera mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu mwene Nebati ntivyari bimuhagije, we yararengejeko, arongora Yezebeli umukobwa wa Etibayali umwami wa Sidoni, aca atangura gukorera ikigirwamana Bayali, aba ari co asenga,
yubaka n’igicaniro mu ngoro y’ico kigirwamana nyene yacubakiye i Samariya.
Ahabu yongera ashinga inkingi za Ashera, akora n’ibindi vyinshi vyatumye uburake bw’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, buziriringa, arusha ibibi abami bose ba Isirayeli batwaye imbere yiwe.

Ku ngoma ya Ahabu ni ho Hiyeli w’i Beteli yasubira kwubaka Yeriko. Agitangura kwubaka umushinge, umuhungu wiwe w’imfura Abiramu arapfa. Amaze guheza inzitiro zaco, umuhungu wiwe w’umuhererezi Segubu na we arapfa. Ivyo vyose vyabaye nk’uko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryari ryarabivuze, riciye mu kanwa ka Yosuwa mwene Nuni.

Hariho umugabo w’i Tishubi i Gileyadi yitwa Eliya, umusi umwe araza abwira Ahabu ati: “Ndakurahiye Uhoraho Imana nzima, Imana ya Isirayeli nkorera, ko ata rume ruzosubira gukoroka canke imvura ngo isubire kugwa muri iyi myaka, kiretse ari jewe ndabivuze.”
Maze Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ribwira Eliya,
riti: “Va ngaha ufate inzira ija mu buseruko, winyegeze hafi y’akuzi Keriti hakurya ya Yorodani.
Uzonywa amazi y’ako kuzi, kandi nategetse ibikona ngo bize bikugaburirireyo.”
Nuko aragenda abikora nk’uko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryabimubwiye. Aja hafi y’ako kuzi Keriti, hakurya ya Yorodani, agumayo.
Ibikona bikama bimuzanira imikate n’inyama mu gatondo no ku mugoroba, akanywa amazi y’ako kuzi.
Haciye igihe ka kuzi karakama, kuko ata mvura yari ikigwa muri ico gihugu.
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ribwira Eliya riti:
“Haguruka ugende i Zarefati igisagara co mu ntara ya Sidoni ugumeyo. Nategetse umupfakazi waho kuzokwama akugaburira.”
Nuko arahaguruka aja i Zarefati. Ashitse kw’irembo ry’igisagara, aca abona umupfakazi yariko arasenya inkwi. Aramuhamagara, amubwira ati: “Ndagusavye umpe utuzi two kunywa mu gikombe.”
Wa mupfakazi agiye, Eliya asubira kumuhamagara, amubwira ati: “Unzanire n’agakate, uzoba ukoze.”

Na we aramwishura ati: “Ndakurahiye ukubaho kw’ Uhoraho Imana yawe, nta mukate ngira. Aha mfise agafu gakeya gasigaye mu gaseke, n’utuvuta dukeya mu gikombe. Aha rero ndiko ndegeranya udukwi kugira ngo ducumbe twe n’umuhungu wanje, turye ubwa nyuma, hanyuma dupfe.”
Eliya aramubwira ati: “Ntutinye. Genda i muhira ukore uko ubivuze. Ariko ubanze unkorere agakate gatoya kuri ivyo ufise hanyuma ukanzanire, maze uheze urondere ivya mwe n’umuhungu wawe.
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: ‘Agaseke kawe ntikazoburamwo ifu, n’igikombe cawe ntikizoburamwo amavuta, gushika aho Uhoraho azorungikira imvura muri iki gihugu.’ ”
Nuko aragenda abikora nk’uko Eliya yabimubwiye. Eliya n’uwo muryango bagumye bafise ivyo barya ico gihe cose.
Amavuta ntiyigeze ahera muri ca gikombe, n’ifu ntiyigeze ihera muri ka gaseke, nk’uko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryari ryabivuze riciye kuri Eliya.
Haciye igihe, umuhugu w’uwo mupfakazi aragwara. Ingwara yiwe ikomeza kwongerekana, gushika aho apfa.
Uwo mugore abarira Eliya ati: “Twapfuye iki ga muntu w’Imana? Waje kumpanira ivyaha vyanje mu kunyicira umwana?”
Eliya amwishura ati: “Nzanira uwo mwana wawe.” Aca aramwakira mu maboko yiwe, amudugana mu cumba co hejuru yabamwo, amuryamika ku buriri bwiwe.
Maze atakambira Uhoraho ati: “ Uhoraho Mana yanje, ni iki gitumye utera amarushwa uwu mupfakazi yampaye indaro, mu kwica umuhungu wiwe?”
Nuko amwubararako incuro zitatu, yongera atakambira Uhoraho avuga ati: “ Uhoraho Mana yanje, ndakwinginze subiza ubuzima uwu mwana!”
Uhoraho yumva ugutakamba kwa Eliya, uwo mwana arahembuka, asubira kuba muzima.
Eliya aca aramuterura, amukura muri ico cumba, amusubiza nyina wiwe avuga ati: “Ehe raba, umuhungu wawe ni muzima!”
Wa mugore aca abarira Eliya ati: “Noneho rero menye ko uri umuntu w’Imana, kandi ko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rica mu kanwa kawe ari iry’ukuri.”
Haciye igihe, mu mwaka ugira gatatu w’urwo ruzuba, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riza kuri Eliya, riti: “Genda wiyereke umwami Ahabu, umubwire ko ngiye kurungika imvura vuba.”
Nuko Eliya aragenda yiyereka Ahabu. Ico gihe inzara yari nyinshi cane i Samariya.
Ahabu atumako Obadiya, yari ajejwe ikirimba. Uwo Obadiya yari umuntu yubaha Uhoraho cane.

Igihe Yezebeli yariko arica abavugishwa b’ Uhoraho , Obadiya yanyegeje abavugishwa ijana mu masenga, mirongo itanu abanyegeza muri rimwe, abandi mirongo itanu mu rindi, akama abagaburirirayo, akabaherayo n’amazi yo kunywa.
Ahabu abarira Obadiya ati: “Reka tugendagende mu gihugu cose, tugenzure amariba n’ibiyaya, kumbure tworonka ahari ubwatsi bw’ifarasi n’inyumbu zacu turabe ko hari na nkeya zorokoka.”
Nuko bagabura amayira, Ahabu afata inzira yiwe, Obadiya na we afata iyiwe.
Obadiya akiri ku nzira agenda, aza abona bahuye na Eliya, aramumenya, aramupfukamira, hanyuma amubaza ati: “Eliya, ni wewe ga nyakwubahwa?”
Eliya amwishura ati: “Ni jewe. Genda ubarire shobuja uti ‘Eliya ari hano.’ ”
Ariko Obadiya aramwankira, avuga ati: “Ni ikihe kibi nagukoreye gitumye undekurira mu maboko ya Ahabu ngo anyice?

Ndakurahiye Uhoraho ko umwami yakurondeye mu mahanga no mu bwami bwose bwo kw’isi, kuva iyo buhera n’iyo buhereza. Kandi igihe cose ihanga canke ubwami bwavuga ko atari ho uri, yarabarahiza ngo bemeze ko bakubuze koko.
None nawe uriko urambwira ngo nje kubwira databuja ko uri ngaha?
Mbega nova ngaha Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho agaca agutwara iyo ntazi, Ahabu ashitse akakurondera akakubura, ntiyoca anyica? Ariko jewe umusavyi wawe namye nubaha Uhoraho kuva mu buto bwanje.

Mbega nyakwubahwa, nta wigeze akubwira ivyo nakoze igihe Yezebeli yariko aratikiza abavugishwa b’ Uhoraho ? Nanyegeje abavugishwa b’ Uhoraho ijana mu masenga abiri, mirongo itanitanu muri rimwe, ndabagaburirirayo, ndabaherayo n’amazi yo kunywa.
None nawe uriko urambarira ngo nje kubwira databuja ko uri ngaha? Mugenzi, yoca anyica!”
Eliya avuga ati: “Ndakurahiye Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana nkorera, ko nza guhagarara imbere ya Ahabu uwu musi.”
Nuko Obadiya aja kurondera Ahabu, arabimubwira. Ahabu na we aca aza guhura na Eliya.
Ahabu abonye Eliya, aramubwira ati: “Ni wewe mbonye, uteje amagorwa nk’aya Isirayeli?”
Eliya amwishura ati: “Nta magorwa nateye Abisirayeli. Ahubwo mwe n’umuryango wa so ni mwebwe mwayabateye. Mwataye ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho , mukurikira Bayali.
Koranya abantu bose bo muri Isirayeli, bansange ku musozi Karumeli. Uzane na ba bavugishwa amajana ane na mirongo itanu ba Bayali, na bamwe amajana ane ba Ashera, basangira na Yezebeli.”
Nuko Ahabu atumako Abisirayeli bose hamwe n’abo bavugishwa, bahurira ku musozi Karumeli.

Eliya ahagarara imbere y’abantu, ababwira ati: “Mbega muzogeza ryari kuba ba nyamujiryanino? Nimba Uhoraho ari we Mana, nabe ari we mukurikira. Kandi nimba Bayali ari yo mana, nabe ari yo mukurikira.” Ariko abantu ntibaronka ico basubizayo.
Eliya yongera ababwira ati: “Ni jewe muvugishwa w’ Uhoraho asigaye, ariko Bayali ifise abavugishwa amajana ane na mirongo itanu.

Nimutuzanire impfizi zibiri hano. Abavugishwa ba Bayali bitoreremwo iyo bashaka, bayibage, bayigereke ku nkwi, ariko ntibadomeke umuriro. Nanje ndabaga iyisigaye, ndayishire ku nkwi, kandi sindomeka umuriro.
Maze muheze mwambaze imana yanyu, nanje ndambaza Uhoraho Imana yanje. Imana iza kurungika umuriro, ni yo izoba ari Imana y’ukuri.” Bose bishurira rimwe bati: “Ivyo uvuze ni vyiza.”
Eliya araheza abarira abavugishwa ba Bayali ati: “Hitamwo impfizi imwe mubanze muyitegure kuko ari mwebwe muri benshi. Muheze muhamagare imana yanyu, ariko ntimudomeke umuriro.”

Nuko bafata impfizi bari hamwe, barayibaga. Baca bahamagara Bayali kuva mu gatondo, bamara umurango wose basemerera, bavuga bati: “Ewe Bayali, nutwumvire, utwishure!” Ariko ntibigera baronka inyishu mu buryo na bumwe. Batangura gutambatamba bazunguruka ico gicaniro bubatse aho hantu.

Hageze nk’isaha zitandatu, Eliya atangura kubashimanga ababwira ati: “Nimusemerere cane! Erega ni imana! Kumbure iri mu vyiyumviro vyinshi, canke ifise akazi kenshi, canke yagiye gutembera. Canke na ho, irasinziriye, ikeneye uwuyivyura.”
Nuko barushirizaho gukoma induru, bikebaguza inkota n’amacumu nk’uko vyari mu migenzo yabo, gushika aho imibiri yabo itemba amaraso.
Isaha zitandatu zirarenga, batangura kwivugisha ibitaja ntibize, gushika igihe co gutanga ibimazi vyo ku mugoroba. Ariko ntibigera bishurwa, canke ngo hagire n’akantu na gatoya kaba.
Eliya aca abwira abantu ati: “Nimwegere hano mwese!” Baramwegera, na we asanura igicaniro c’ Uhoraho cari carasenyutse.
Afata amabuye cumi n’abiri, nk’uko imiryango ya bene Yakobo ingana, ari we ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryabwiye riti: “Kuva ubu, uzokwitwa Isirayeli.”
Ayo mabuye ayubakisha igicaniro c’ Uhoraho , yimba umuvo ugikikuje, uwo muvo washobora kwuzuzwa n’ingero seya zibiri z’imbuto.
Ashira inkwi ku gicaniro, abaga ya mpfizi, agereka inyama zayo kuri za nkwi. Aca avuga ati: “Nimwuzuze amazi imibindi minini ine, muheze muyasuke kuri ico kimazi n’izo nkwi.”
Ababwira ati: “Nimusukeko ayandi.” Barasubira basukako ayandi. Yongera kubabwira ati: “Nimusukeko n’irya gatatu.” Na bo basukako ayandi irya gatatu.
Ya mazi araseseka ku mpande zose z’igicaniro, gushika aho na wa muvo wuzura.

Igihe co gushikana ibimazi kigeze, Eliya yegera igicaniro, asenga avuga ati: “ Uhoraho Mana ya Aburahamu na Isaka na Yakobo, uwu musi bigaragare ko ari wewe Mana ya Isirayeli, kandi ko ndi umusavyi wawe, ko nakoze ibi vyose kuko ari wewe wabintumye.
Ewe Uhoraho , unyishure. Unyishure kugira ngo aba bantu bamenye ko wewe Uhoraho ari wewe Mana y’ukuri, kandi ko ari wewe usubiriye kwigarurirako imitima yabo.”
Ubwo nyene umuriro w’ Uhoraho uca urakoroka uvuye mw’ijuru, utongora ca kimazi, uturira za nkwi na ya mabuye, mbere ukamya na ya mazi yari yuzuye umuvo.
Abantu bose babibonye bikubita hasi bubamye, bavuga bati: “ Uhoraho ni we Mana! Uhoraho ni we Mana!”

Eliya aca atanga itegeko ati: “Nimufate abavugishwa ba Bayali bose, ntihagire n’umwe abaca mu myanya y’intoke!” Nuko barabafata bose, Eliya ababwira ko babajana mu kiyaya ca Kishoni, barabajana, abicirayo.
Eliya abarira Ahabu ati: “Genda ufungure, unywe, kuko ndumva ko imvura nyishi iriko irasuma.”
Nuko Ahabu aragenda, arafungura, aranywa. Ariko Eliya aduga hejuru ku musozi Karumeli, arapfukama, acurika umutwe mu maguru, arasenga.
Abarira umukozi wiwe ati: “Genda utereze amaso hejuru y’ikiyaga.” Wa mukozi aragenda, araraba, aragaruka abarira Eliya ati: “Nta co mbonye.” Eliya amurungika kuraba incuro indwi.

Ku ncuro igira indwi, wa mukozi wiwe amubwira ati: “Mbonye agacu gatoya kangana n’ikiganza c’umuntu, kaduga kava ku kiyaga.” Eliya aca amubwira ati: “Irukanga ubwire Ahabu uti: ‘Urira umukogote wawe usubire i muhira imvura itarakubuza gutaha!’ ”
Muri ako kanya nyene ikirere gitangura kwirabura kubera ibicu, umuyaga urahuhuta, haza imvura y’isegenya. Ahabu aca yirukanga aja i Yezireyeli.
Ububasha bw’ Uhoraho buza kuri Eliya, akenyeza umukanda umutamana wiwe, yiruka imbere ya Ahabu gushika kw’Irembo rya Yezireyeli.
Maze Ahabu adondera Yezebeli ivyo Eliya yakoze vyose, kandi ko yicishije inkota abavugishwa ba Bayali bose.
Yezebeli aca arungika intumwa kuri Eliya kumubwira iti: “Imana zimpane, kandi zize zimpane birushirije cane, ejo umusi niwashika aha uwu ushitse ntarakugira nk’uko wagize abo bavugishwa bandi.”
Eliya aca aterwa n’ubwoba, aca arahunga kugira ngo akize amagara yiwe. Ageze i Berisheba mu Buyuda, ahasiga wa mukozi wiwe.

Afata urugendo wenyene aja mu bugaragwa, amara umusi wose agenda. Arahava ashikira igiti c’umurotemu, yicara mu gitutu caco, yisabira gupfa ati: “Ewe Uhoraho , ibi biramaze. Ndeka mpfe, sinsumba ba sogokuruza.”
Aca aryama musi y’ico giti, arasinzira. Ariko agisinzira, haza umumarayika aramukoma, amubwira ati: “Vyuka urye.”
Yikanguye abona umutsima ugeretse ku makara yaka, hamwe n’agakarabo k’amazi. Ararya, anywa n’ayo mazi, aca arasubira ariryamira.
Wa mumarayika aragaruka irya kabiri, aramukoma, amubwira ati: “Vyuka urye, unywe, kuko urugendo ruri imbere yawe ari rurerure cane.”
Arikangura, ararya, anywa n’amazi. Ivyo vyokurya bimuha inkomezi amara imisi mirongo ine n’amajoro mirongo ine agenda, gushika ashike ku musozi Horebu, ari wo musozi w’Imana.
Ashitseyo, yinjira mw’isenga ararayo. Hanyuma Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimubaza riti: “Eliya, aho uhakora iki?”

Na we arishura ati: “Nagiriye ishaka ryinshi Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose. Ariko Abisirayeli bataye isezerano, basenyagura ibicaniro vyawe, baranduza inkota abavugishwa bawe. Ni jewe jenyene nari nsigaye, none na jewe bariko barandondera ngo banyice.”

Uhoraho amubwira ati: “Sohoka uje guhagarara imbere yanje ku musozi, kuko ngira ndahace.” Maze Eliya ahagaze ngaho, haza umuyaga w’igihuhusi ukomeye cane, usatura imisozi, umenagura n’ibitandara imbere y’ Uhoraho , ariko Uhoraho ntiyari muri uwo muyaga. Inyuma yawo haza nyamugigima, ariko Uhoraho ntiyari muri yo.
Inyuma ya nyamugigima haza umuriro, ariko Uhoraho ntiyari muri uwo muriro. Inyuma y’uwo muriro haza agacere, humvikana ikimeze nk’akajwi gatoya kongorera.
Eliya akumvise yiyambura umutamana awitwikira mu maso, aca ariruka ahagarara ku rwinjiriro rw’iryo senga. Aca yumva ijwi rimubaza riti: “Eliya, aha uhakora iki?”

Na we arishura ati: “Nagiriye ishaka ryinshi Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose. Ariko Abisirayeli bataye isezerano, basenyagura ibicaniro vyawe, baranduza inkota abavugishwa bawe. Ni jewe jenyene nari nsigaye, none na jewe bariko barandondera ngo banyice.”
Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Fata inzira wazananye, usubire inyuma, uje mu bugaragwa bw’i Damasiko. Niwashikayo, uzorobanuze amavuta Hazayeli, abe umwami w’i Siriya.
Wongere urobanure Yehu mwene Nimushi, abe umwami wa Isirayeli, urobanure na Elisa mwene Shafati w’i Abeli-Mehola, abe ari we azogusubirira mu buvugishwa.
Uwuzokira inkota ya Hazayeli, azokwica na Yehu; uwuzokira inkota ya Yehu, azokwica abazocika na Elisa.
Ariko rero nariziganirije abantu ibihumbi indwi muri Isirayeli batigeze bapfukamira Bayali, canke ngo bayisome.”

Nuko Eliya ava aho aragenda, abona Elisa mwene Shafati ariko ararimisha inka cumi na zibiri, zifatanijwe n’ingogo ari zibirizibiri, na we ari imbere yazo. Eliya aramwegera amutererako umutamana wiwe ku bitugu, hanyuma arigira.
Elisa aca asiga ngaho za nka ziwe zirima, akurikira Eliya. Amubwira ati: “Reka nje gusezera data na mama, mpeze nze tujane.” Eliya aramubwira ati: “Genda, ariko wibuke ico nagukoreye.”

Elisa aca ava inyuma yiwe, asubira inyuma. Afata inka zibiri zifatanijwe n’ingogo, arazibaga. Avunagura ingogo, azicanisha umuriro, ateka za nyama, azigaburira abantu, barazirya. Aca avaho akurikira Eliya, aba umukozi wiwe.
Ico gihe Beni-Hadadi umwami w’i Siriya akoranya abasoda biwe bose, aduga aherekejwe n’abami mirongo itatu na babiri bari ku mafarasi n’imikogote yabo, bakikuza Samariya, barahatera.
Beni-Hadadi arungika intumwa mu gisagara ca Ahabu umwami wa Isirayeli ati: “Beni-Hadadi avuze ati:
‘Inzahabu n’ifeza ufise vyose ni ivyanje, co kimwe n’abagore bawe n’abana bawe!’ ”
Umwami wa Isirayeli yishura ati: “Nibibe nk’uko ubivuze, mwami wanje. Na jewe ubwanje hamwe n’ivyanje vyose, turi abawe.”
Za ntumwa zisubira kuja kwa Ahabu zimubwira ziti: “Beni-Hadadi avuze ati: ‘Nagutumyeko intumwa kugira ngo umpe ifeza n’inzahabu vyawe, hamwe n’abagore bawe n’abana bawe.
Ariko ejo, umusi niwagera aha uwu ugeze, nzorungika abantu banje, basake ikirimba cawe hamwe n’amazu y’abatware bawe. Ic’agaciro cose bazosangayo, bazogitwara.’ ”
Umwami wa Isirayeli aca ahamagaza abatware ba Isirayeli bose, ababwira ati: “Murabona ingene uwu mugabo agomba gukwega intambara! Igihe yansaba abagore n’abana banje, inzahabu n’ifeza, sinabimwimye.”
Ba batware bamubwira bati: “Ntihagire ikintu na kimwe usubira kumwemerera.”

Ahabu yishura za ntumwa za Beni-Hadadi ati: “Gende mubwire umwami databuja muti: ‘Umusavyi wawe azotanga ivyo wamusavye ubwa mbere, ariko ivyo usavye ubu nta vyo yemeye.’ ” Nuko basubira inyuma bashikiriza inyishu Beni-Hadadi.
Na we asubira kurungika intumwa ati: “Imana zibimpanire, ndetse birushirije, i Samariya nihasigara n’agakungugu kokwuzura ibiganza vy’abasoda banje.”
Umwami wa Isirayeli abishura ati: “Genda mumubwire muti: ‘Uwambara ibigwanisho agiye ku rugamba ntakirate nk’uwuvyambura arunesheje.’ ”
Beni-Hadadi yumvise iyo nyishu ari kumwe n’abandi bami bariko banywera mu mahema yabo, aca atanga itegeko ati: “Nimwitegure tugire igitero!” Nuko baca baritegura ngo batere igisagara.

Muri ico gihe nyene, umuvugishwa aza aho Ahabu umwami wa Isirayeli ari, amubwira ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Wabonye ko izo ngabo zigukikuje ari nyishi? Uwu musi ndabarekurira mu maboko yawe, ni ho uza kumenya ko ndi Uhoraho .’ ”

Ahabu aramubaza ati: “None azokoresha nde?” Wa muvugishwa aramwishura ati: “ Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Ni abasoda b’imikangara bagabwa n’abakuru b’intara.’ ” Ahabu yongera kumubaza ati: “None ni nde azotangura gutera?” Wa muvugishwa na we ati: “Wewe.”
Ahabu aca akoranya imikangara yose igabwa n’abatware b’intara, bari amajana abiri na mirongo itatu na babiri. Akoranya n’abandi basoda b’Abisirayeli, bose hamwe bari ibihumbi indwi.
Nk’igihe c’isaha zitandatu, Beni-Hadadi na ba bami mirongo itatu na babiri bari bifatanije na we bakiriko baranywa bibereye mu mahema yabo,
ya mikangara irasohoka iva mu gisagara. Begereje, abareretsi ba Beni-Hadadi baraza bamubwira bati: “Hari igitero c’abasoda baje bava i Samariya.”
Beni-Hadadi aca abategeka ati: “Baje gusaba amahoro canke baje kugwana, uko baza kwose mubafate ari bazima.”
Ya mikangara n’abakuru b’intara barasohoka bava mu gisagara n’abandi basoda inyuma yabo, baja kugwana.

Umwisirayeli wese yica uwo bagwana, maze abasoda bose ba Siriya bacika ivutu, bakura hasi barahunga, Abisirayeli barabakinagiza. Beni-Hadadi umwami w’i Siriya ari kumwe n’abandi bakeya, burira ku mafarasi barahunga.
Ariko umwami wa Isirayeli akurikira abasigaye, arabica, atikiza amafarasi n’imikogote yabo, haba agatikizo gakomeye ku ruhande rwa Aramu.

Haciye igihe, wa muvugishwa yongera kuza ku mwami wa Isirayeli, amubwira ati: “Tegura neza igisoda cawe, wongere ugire integuro nziza y’intambara, kuko imvura niyacika, umwami wa Siriya azosubira kugutera.”
Maze abasoda b’umwami wa Siriya bamuhanura bati: “Imana z’Abisirayeli, ni imana zo ku mitumba. Ni co gituma batunesheje. Nitwabagwaniriza mu biyaya, nta kabuza tuzobatsinda.
Ubu ico ukwiye gukora ni iki: kura abami bose mu mabanga yo kurongora abasoda, uhashire intwazangabo.

Wongere ukoranye abasoda bangana na barya wabuze, hamwe n’amafarasi n’imikogote bingana na birya wabuze, maze duheze tuje kubagwaniriza mu biyaya. Nta kabuza, tuzobanesha.” Umwami Beni-Hadadi yemeranya na bo, abigenza uko bamuhanuye.
Ku gacikamvura gakurikira, Beni-Hadadi yegeranya abasoda b’Abasiriya, aduga muri Efeki kugwanya Abisirayeli.
Abasoda b’Abisirayeli na bo bari bakoranye, biteguye bikwiye, baja kubagwanya.

Wa muntu w’Imana araza abarira umwami wa Isirayeli ati: “ Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Kubera Abasiriya bibaza ko Uhoraho ari imana yo ku mitumba atari iyo mu biyaya, nzorekurira mu maboko yawe izo ngabo nyinshi gutyo, kugira ngo umenya ko ndi Uhoraho .’ ”
Bamara imisi indwi bari mu makambi yabo bahanganye, maze ku musi ugira indwi batana mu mitwe. Abisirayeli bica abasoda ibihumbi ijana b’Abasiriya bagwanira ku maguru.
Abasigaye bahungira mu gisagara ca Efeki, ariko uruzitiro rw’igisagara ruhenukira ku bihumbi mirongo ibiri n’indwi muri bo. Beni-Hadadi ahungira mu gisagara, yinyegeza mu cumba c’imbere.

Abatware biwe baramubwira bati: “Twarumvise ko abami b’Abisirayeli ari abanyembabazi. Reka tuje ku mwami wa Isirayeli dukenyeye amagunira, twihambiriye imikanda mw’izosi. Kumbure umwami Ahabu yokugirira imbabazi.”

Nuko bakenyera amagunira, bihambira imikanda mw’izosi, baja ku mwami wa Isirayeli bamubwira bati: “Umusavyi wawe Beni-Hadadi avuze ati: ‘Ndakwinginze ungirire imbabazi.’ ” Umwami wa Isirayeli yishura ati: “Aracariho? Ni umuvukanyi wanje!”

Abo bantu bavyumvise bibatera ivyizigiro. Bishura bati: “Egome cane, Beni-Hadadi umuvukanyi wawe aracariho.” Umwami ababwira ati: “Genda mumuzane!” Beni-Hadadi arasohoka, Ahabu na we amwuriza mu mukogote wiwe.

Beni-Hadadi abwira Ahabu ati: “Nzogusubiza ibisagara vyose data yanyaze so, kugira ngo nawe wiyubakire isoko i Damasiko nk’uko data na we yaryubatse i Samariya.” Ahabu na we amubwira ati: “Niwansezeranira ivyo, nanje ndakureka wigire amahoro.” Nuko bagiranira iryo sezerano, hanyuma aramureka arigira.
Ico gihe Uhoraho ategeka umwe mu bavugishwa kubwira mugenziwe ati: “Nkubita n’ico kigwanisho cawe!” Ariko uwo muntu yanka kukimukubita.
Wa muvugishwa aca abwira mugenziwe ati: “Ko utumviye Uhoraho , aho uvira ngaha intare iraza kukurya.” Wa muntu amaze kuva ngaho akagenda, intare iramutera, iramurya.
Wa muvugishwa aja kubwira uwundi mugabo ati: “Nkubita!” Wa muntu aramukubita, aramukomeretsa.
Wa muvugishwa arahaguruka, aja guhagarara ku nzira arindiriye umwami, yitwikirije igitambara mu maso kugira ngo yiyoberanye.

Umwami ahaciye, wa muvugishwa aca arasemerera ati: “Mwami wanje, jewe umusavyi wawe nari ku rugamba, hanyuma umwe mu basoda anzanira imbohe, ambwira ati: ‘Uyigumye, kandi ikagutorokana urapfa canke utange italanto imwe y’ifeza.’
Ariko ndavye hirya gato, ya mbohe irantorokana iragenda.” Umwami wa Isirayeli ati: “Urubanza ruragutsinze, kandi ni wewe nyene urwiciriye.”
Ubwo nyene wa muvugishwa aca akura ca gitambara mu maso, umwami wa Isirayeli aca aramenya ko ari umwe mu bavugishwa.
Wa muvugishwa aca amubwira ati: “ Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Warekuye umuntu nari nategetse ko apfa, none rero ubuzima bwawe ni bwo buhasigara, kandi abantu bawe ni bo bapfa mu kibanza c’abantu biwe.’ ”
Nuko umwami wa Isirayeli aca asubira ku kirimba ciwe i Samariya ababaye, yijiriwe.
Kandi ico gihe hariho umuntu yitwa Naboti w’i Yezireyeli, yari afise itongo ry’imizabibu aho nyene i Yezireyeli, hafi y’ikirimba ca Ahabu umwami w’i Samariya.
Ahabu abarira Naboti ati: “Mpa uruzabibu rwawe ndarurimemwo imboga, kuko ruri hafi y’ikirimba canje. Nanje ndaguha urundi ruzabibu rwiza gusumba urwo, canke na ho ushatse ndarukugurire amahera.”
Ariko Naboti yishura Ahabu ati: “ Uhoraho ntakavyumve ko noguha iragi rya ba sogokuruza.”
Ahabu ataha iwe, yijiriwe, ababajwe n’uko Naboti w’i Yezireyeli amubwiye ati: “Sindaguha iragi rya ba sogokuruza.” Aryama ku buriri bwiwe araba ku ruhome, yanka no kurya.
Umugore wiwe Yezebeli yinjira aho aryamye amubaza ati: “Ni kubera iki wijiriwe? Ni iki gitumye utarya?”
Aramwishura ati: “Nabwiye Naboti w’i Yezireyeli nti: ‘Ndakugurire uruzabibu rwawe, canke ushatse ndaguhe urundi ruzabibu.’ ” Ariko yambwiye ati: “Sinshobora kuguha uruzabibu rwanje.”
Yezebeli aramubaza ati: “Mbega si wewe uri umwami wa Isirayeli? Vyuka ufungure, ushire umubabaro. Urwo ruzabibu rwa Naboti w’i Yezireyeli jewe nzoruguha.”
Nuko aca yandika amakete kw’izina rya Ahabu, ayaterako n’ikidodo ciwe, ayarungikira abatware n’abubahwa bo mu gisagara Naboti yabamwo.
Muri ayo makete yandika ati: “Nimushinge umusi wo kwisonzesha, hanyuma Naboti abe ari we mushira imbere arongore abandi.
Muce murondera abantu babiri bashirukanya, bagirize Naboti ko yatutse Imana n’umwami. Muce mumusohokana mumwicishe amabuye.”
Nuko abatware n’abubahwa bo mu gisagara Naboti yabamwo babikora nk’uko Yezebeli yabibabwiye muri ayo makete yabandikiye.
Bashinga umusi wo kwisonzesha, bashira Naboti imbere y’ikoraniro.

Haca haza abantu babiri bicara aharabana n’aho Naboti yari yicaye, bamwagiriza imbere y’abantu bavuga bati: “Naboti yatutse Imana n’umwami.” Baca baramufata bamusohokana inyuma y’igisagara, bamwicisha amabuye.
Baca barungika intumwa kuri Yezebeli bati: “Naboti yicishijwe amabuye.”
Yezebeli yumvise ko Naboti yicishijwe amabuye, aragenda abwira Ahabu ati: “Vyuka uje gushikira rwa ruzabibu rwa Naboti w’i Yezireyeli yari yanse kuguha. Ntakiri muzima, yapfuye.”
Ahabu yumvise ko Naboti w’i Yezireyeli yapfuye, aca arahaguruka aja kwigarurira rwa ruzabibu rwiwe.
Ariko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riza kuri Eliya Umunyetishubi,
riti: “Manuka urabe Ahabu umwami wa Isirayeli aba i Samariya. Ubu ari mu ruzabibu rwa Naboti urwo yigaruriye.
Umubwire uti: ‘Wishe umuntu none wigaruriye n’utwiwe!’ Wongere umubwire uti: ‘ Uhoraho avuze ati: Ko ukoze ivyo, imbwa zizorigatira amaraso yawe inyuma y’igisagara, aho zarigatiye aya Naboti.’ ”
Ahabu aca abwira Eliya ati: “Urandonse akaryo, wa mwansi wanje we!” Eliya amwishura ati: “Ndakuronse akaryo nyene, kuko wiyeguriye gukora ibibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho .
Uhoraho agiye kugusukako ivyago, arandure uruvyaro rwawe, arandure abo mu nzu ya Ahabu gushika ku muhungu wa nyuma muri Isirayeli, yaba umugurano canke uwidegemvya.
Umuryango wawe azowutikiza nk’uwa Yerobowamu mwene Nebati canke uwa Bayasha mwene Ahiya, kuko wamuteye ubushangashirwe, ugakwegera Abisirayeli mu vyaha.
Nayo ku vyerekeye Yezebeli, Uhoraho yambwiye ko imbwa zizorira umuvyimba wiwe ku ruzitiro rw’i Yezireyeli.
Abo mu muryango wawe bazogwa mu gisagara, bazoribwa n’imbwa, abazogwa mu gahinga na bo bazoribwa n’ibisiga vyo mu kirere.”
(Nta muntu n’umwe yari yarihebeye gukora ibibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho kunganya Ahabu, abikwegewemwo n’umugore wiwe Yezebeli.
Yakoze ivy’agahomerabunwa vyinshi mu gusenga ibishushanyo nk’uko Abamori babisenga, abo Uhoraho yari yirukanye imbere y’Abisirayeli.)
Ahabu yumvise ayo majambo, yitabagurirako impuzu, yambara amagunira, arisonzesha. Mbere akaryama yambaye igunira, akagenda yipfumbereje.
Maze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riza kuri Eliya Umunyetishubi,
riti: “Wabonye ingene Ahabu yicishije bugufi imbere yanje? Ko yicishije bugufi, sinzomushitsako ibi vyago mu gihe azoba akiriho. Nzobishitsa ku muryango wiwe mu gihe hazoba hatwara umuhungu wiwe.”
Abisirayeli n’Abasiriya bamara imyaka itatu ata ntambara ibaye hagati yabo.
Ariko mu mwaka ugira kane, Yehoshafati umwami w’i Buyuda amanuka kuramutsa Ahabu umwami wa Isirayeli.
Umwami wa Isirayeli yari yarabwiye abatware biwe ati: “Mbega ntimuzi ko igisagara ca Ramoti Gileyadi cari icacu? Ko mbona ata co turiko turakora ngo tucake umwami w’i Siriya?”
Nuko abaza Yehoshafati ati: “Mbega wojana nanje gutera Ramoti Gileyadi?” Yehoshafati yishura umwami w’Abisirayeli ati: “Twe nawe turi bamwe, abantu banje ni abawe, n’amafarasi yanje ni ayawe.”
Ariko Yehoshafati yongerako abwira umwami w’Abisirayeli ati: “Reka tubanze tugishe inama Uhoraho .”

Nuko umwami w’Abisirayeli akoranya abavugishwa; bose hamwe bari abagabo amajana ane. Araheza ababaza ati: “Mbega mubona twoja gutera i Ramoti Gileyadi, canke tureke?” Barishura bati: “Nimugende, kuko Imana izohatanga mu kuboko kwawe mwami.”
Ariko Yehoshafati arabaza ati: “Mbega ngaha nta muvugishwa w’ Uhoraho n’umwe akihari twobaza?”

Umwami w’Abisirayeli yishura Yehoshafati ati: “Haracariho uwundi muvugishwa umwe yotubariza Uhoraho , ariko ndamwanka kuko atigera avugishwa ivyiza kuri jewe, atari ibibi. Ni Mikaya mwene Imula.” Yehoshafati aramwishura ati: “Umwami ntakwiye kuvuga atyo.”
Nuko umwami w’Abisirayeli ahamagara umwe mu batware biwe amubwira ati: “Nyaruka uzane Mikaya mwene Imula.”

Ahabu umwami w’Abisirayeli na Yehoshafati umwami w’i Buyuda, bari bambaye amakanzu yabo y’inyambarabami, bicara ku ntebe z’ubwami ku mbuga yo gusekurirako ingano iri kw’irembo ry’i Samariya, abavugishwa bavugishirizwa imbere yabo.
Maze Zedekiya mwene Kenayana yari yarakoze amahembe y’icuma, aca avuga ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Aya ni yo uzokwicisha Abasiriya gushika ubaranduye.’ ”
Abandi bavugishwa bose na bo nyene bavugishwa ukwo nyene, bati: “Genda utere i Ramoti Gileyadi, uzohatsinda, kuko Uhoraho azohatanga mu maboko y’umwami.”

Ya ntumwa yari yagiye guhamagara Mikaya iramubwira iti: “Raba abandi bavugishwa bose bahurije hamwe nk’umuntu umwe mu kuvugishwa intsinzi y’umwami. Ijambo ryawe rero rize guhura n’iryabo, uvuge ivyiza.”
Ariko Mikaya amwishura ati: “Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , ico Uhoraho ambwira ni co nja kuvuga.”
Ashitse, umwami aramubaza ati: “Mikaya, mbega tuje gutera i Ramoti Gileyadi, canke tureke?” Aramwishura ati: “Genda uhatere kandi uzotsinda, kuko Uhoraho azohatanga mu maboko yawe mwami.”
Umwami aca amubwira ati: “Nzogeza ryari kukurahiza kugira ngo ntihagire ikindi umbwira atari ukuri mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ?”

Mikaya amwishura ati: “Mu kwerekwa nabonye Abisirayeli bashwiragiye ku misozi nk’intama zitagira umwungere, Uhoraho aca ambarira ati: ‘Abo bantu ntibagira shebuja. Barungike umwe wese atahe mu rugo rwiwe amahoro.’ ”
Umwami w’Abisirayeli abarira Yehoshafati ati: “Sinakubwiye ko atigera avugishwa iciza na kimwe kuri jewe, atari ibibi gusa?”
Mikaya arabandanya ati: “Nuko niwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho: Nabonye Uhoraho avyagiye ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami ari kumwe n’ingabo zo mw’ijuru zihagaze i buryo n’i bubamfu bwiwe.
Maze Uhoraho avuga ati: ‘Ni nde yokwosha Ahabu ngo aje gutera i Ramoti Gileyadi kugira ngo aze yicirweyo?’ Umwe akavuga ibi, uwundi ibindi.
Mu nyuma ni ho haza impwemu ihagarara imbere y’ Uhoraho , imubwira iti: ‘Jewe nomwosha!’ Uhoraho ayibaza ati: ‘Uzobikora gute?’
Uhoraho arayibaza ati: ‘Uzobigenza gute?’ Na yo yishura iti: ‘Nzosohoka mbe impwemu yo kubesha mu kanwa k’abavugishwa biwe bose.’ Uhoraho ayibwira ati: ‘Ni vyo, uzoshobora kumwosha! Genda ubikore.’
None rero, ehe raba Uhoraho yashize impwemu yo kubesha mu kanwa k’abavugishwa bawe bose, kuko yamaze gufata ingingo yo kugusukako ivyago.”
Nuko Zedekiya mwene Kenayana ava hasi akubita ikofe Mikaya. Amubaza ati: “Iyo mpwemu y’ Uhoraho yaciye hehe iva kuri jewe iza kuvugana nawe?”
Mikaya amwishura ati: “Uzobimenya umusi uzobura aho winyegeza, ukajarajara uva mu cumba kimwe uja mu kindi.”
Umwami w’Abisirayeli atanga itegeko ati: “Nimumufate, mumujane kwa Amoni umukuru w’igisagara no kwa Yowashi umwana w’umwami.
Mubabwire muti: ‘Umwami avuze ngo: Uyu mugabo nimumushire mw’ibohero, ntihagire ikindi mumugaburira atari umukate n’amazi vy’inticantikize, gushika aho nzogarukira amahoro mvuye ku rugamba!’ ”
Mikaya na we aca avuga ati: “Niwagaruka amahoro, nzoba ntavugishijwe n’ Uhoraho !” Yongera abwira abari ngaho ati: “Yemwe bantu mwese, muraba muvyumvise!”
Nuko umwami w’Abisirayeli na Yehoshafati umwami w’i Buyuda, baduga i Ramoti Gileyadi.
Umwami wa Isirayeli abarira Yehoshafati ati: “Nja kwinjira mu rugamba niyoberanije, ariko wewe ugume wambaye impuzu zawe z’inyambarabami.” Nuko umwami wa Isirayeli ariyoberanya aja ku rugamba.
Umwami w’i Siriya ategeka abarongora abagwanira ku mikogote yiwe mirongo itatu na babiri ati: “Ntihagire uwundi muntu n’umwe mutera, yaba muto canke mukuru, atari umwami w’Abisirayeli.”
Ba bakuru b’abagwanira ku mikogote babonye Yehoshafati, baribwira bati: “Nta gukeka, uwu ni we mwami w’Abisirayeli.” Nuko barahindukira ngo bamutere, ariko Yehoshafati arataka,
umukuru wabo aca arabona ko atari we mwami wa Isirayeli, ni ko kumuva inyuma bakamureka.

Ariko umuntu umwe afora umuheto apfa kurasa, aca agema umwami w’Abisirayeli aho ivyuma bimukingira bihurira. Umwami aca abwira uwatwara umukogote wiwe ati: “Hindukira unkure mu rugamba, ndakomeretse.”

Ariko kuri uwo musi, urugamba rurushiriza gukomera maze umwami bapfa kumushigikirira aho nyene mu mukogote, aguma ameze nk’uwuhanganye n’Abasiriya. Ca gikomere kiva amaraso menshi, atembera mu mukogote, hageze ku mugoroba, aracikana.
Izuba ririko rirarenga, itegeko rikwira mu bari ku rugamba bose, rivuga riti: “Umwe wese nasubire mu gisagara ciwe; umwe wese nasubire i muhira iwe!”
Nuko umwami arapfa, bamutahana i Samariya, bamuhambayo.
Wa mukogote bawogereza ku kidengeri c’i Samariya aho ba maraya biyuhagirira, imbwa zirigata amaraso yiwe nk’uko Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryari ryabivuze.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Ahabu, hamwe n’ikirimba gisharijwe n’amahembe y’inzovu yubatse n’ibisagara yubatse, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku bami ba Isirayeli.
Ahabu ahamvya ba sekuruza, umuhungu wiwe Ahaziya aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Yehoshafati mwene Asa yabaye umwami w’i Buyuda mu mwaka ugira kane Ahabu ari umwami wa Isirayeli.
Yehoshafati yari afise imyaka mirongo itatu n’itanu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aganza imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Azuba, umukobwa wa Shiluhi.

Agendera mu nzira za se Asa muri vyose, kandi ntiyakikama ngo azivemwo; akora ibigororotse mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho . Ariko ku ngoma yiwe ntiyashoboye gukuraho ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku mataba y’imisozi; abantu babandanije gushikanirayo ibimazi no gutuririraho ibimota neza.
Kandi Yehoshafati yabanye amahoro n’umwami wa Isirayeli.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yehoshafati, ivy’ubutwari bwiwe, ivyo yakoze n’ivy’intambara yagwanye, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyagenda biraba ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda?
Yirukana mu gihugu ciwe abagabo n’abagore b’abamaraya mu bibanza vyo gusengeramwo bari basigaye ku bari bahari mu gihe ca se Asa.
Ico gihe muri Edomu nta mwami bari bafise, abakuru b’intara ni bo batwara.
Ico gihe Yehoshafati yubakisha amato maninimanini nk’ay’i Tarushishi yo kuja i Ofiru kuzana inzahabu, ariko ntiyigeze ava aho ari kuko yaciye amenekera i Eziyoni Geberi.
Ico gihe kandi, Ahaziya mwene Ahabu yari yabwiye Yehoshafati ati: “Reka abantu banje basozanye n’abawe.” Ariko Yehoshafati aramwankira.
Maze Yehoshafati arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa mu Gisagara ca sekuruza Dawidi, umuhungu wiwe Yehoramu amusubirira ku ngoma.
Ahaziya mwene Ahabu yabaye umwami wa Isirayeli aba i Samariya mu mwaka ugira cumi n’indwi Yehoshafati ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, amara imyaka ibiri ku ngoma.
Akora ibibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , kuko yagendeye mu ngeso za se na nyina, no mu za Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, umwe yakwegera Abisirayeli mu vyaha.
Yakoreye Bayali yongera arayisenga, avyura ishavu ry’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli, nk’uko se yabigize.
